data.title: Understanding Memory Management, Part 5: Fighting with Rust
data.author: Curiositry
data.article_summary: 这篇文章是关于Rust内存管理的系列文章的第五部分，重点讨论了在Rust中进行复杂操作时需要注意的所有权和借用问题。文章通过一个简单的代码示例展示了在使用`for`循环遍历向量时出现的所有权转移错误。具体来说，Rust在调用`into_iter()`时会获取向量`x`的所有权，导致后续无法再次使用`x`。为了避免这个问题，可以使用对向量`x`的引用，即`&x`。文章还解释了Rust中的语法糖以及不同类型的方法调用（如引用、可变引用和所有权转移），并通过进一步的代码示例展示了如何正确使用这些特性。总的来说，文章深入探讨了Rust中所有权和借用的实际应用，帮助开发者更好地理解和解决相关问题。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Rust语言的内存管理、函数重载、编译器行为以及与其他语言（如Zig、C++、GC语言）的比较。

不同观点：
• **关于函数重载的技术细节**：
   - steveklabnik指出，Rust不支持传统意义上的函数重载，而是通过trait的不同实现来达到类似效果。这避免了潜在的编译器错误，因为可以明确选择正确的实现。
   - 他还提到，虽然这可能导致编译器报错，但通过手动选择可以避免问题，且这不算作破坏性变更。

• **Rust内存管理的优劣**：
   - teleforce认为，21世纪的编程语言应具备完美的垃圾回收（GC）机制，而不是像Rust那样手动管理内存。他用汽车行业的自动变速箱类比，说明自动化管理应是趋势。
   - Animats则解释了Rust内存管理的核心原则，包括单一所有权和借用检查器的作用，认为理解这些原则后，Rust的设计是合理的。
   - rollcat对比了Zig和Rust的内存管理策略，认为Zig的策略对开发者更友好，但Rust更严格，虽然常常“大喊”（编译错误），但往往是有道理的。

• **Rust编译器和语言复杂性的争议**：
   - diath抱怨即使是简单的"for x in y"循环，Rust也需要复杂的处理，认为这是Rust ergonomics差的表现。
   - cornholio认为Rust将复杂的内存管理强加给程序员，带来的收益（如性能提升）对于非系统编程来说不值得。
   - Surac虽然觉得Rust有些概念过于冗长，但总体上理解了Rust的优点，并计划从Rust中借鉴一些想法用于C/C++开发。
   - gitroom也有类似感受，怀念C的简单，但坚持使用Rust以减少bug。

• **其他技术细节和个人观点**：
   - bsaul指出了一个代码示例中的小错误，关于"`.set_value()`应为`&mut self`而非`&self`"。
   - sidcool简单称赞了文章写得好。
   - dmitrygr则表示不愿意浪费时间在诸如"为什么需要`&x`来修复问题"这样的细节上。

补充讨论：
- Rust的借用检查器和所有权模型是讨论的核心，支持者认为这些特性带来了更高的代码健壮性，反对者则认为这增加了不必要的复杂性。
- 关于Rust与Zig、C++、GC语言的对比也是讨论的一个重点，反映出不同开发者对语言设计和使用体验的不同偏好。
- 总体上，Rust的严格性和编译器“喊叫”是争议的焦点，部分开发者认为这是提高代码质量的必要代价，另一部分则觉得这种复杂性影响了开发体验。

Understanding Memory Management, Part 5: Fighting with Rust
Posted by
ekr
on 20 Apr 2025
This is the fifth post in my planned multipart series on memory
management. You will probably want to go back and read Part
I
, which covers C, parts
II
and
III
, which cover C++, and part
IV
, which introduces Rust memory
management.  In part IV, we got through the basics of Rust memory
management up through smart pointers. In this post I want
to look at some of the gymnastics you need to engage in to do
serious work in Rust.
Unexpected Moves
#
Consider the following simple Rust code:
fn
main
(
)
{
let
x
=
vec!
[
1
,
2
]
;
for
y
in
x
{
println!
(
"{}"
,
y
)
;
}
println!
(
"{}"
,
x
.
len
(
)
)
;
}
This is straightforward: we create a vector containing the values
[1, 2]
, then iterate over it and print each element, and then
finally print out the length of the vector. This is the kind of
code people write every day. Let's see what happens when we compile
it.
Error[E0382]: borrow of moved value: `x`
--> iter_into.rs:7:20
|
2   |     let x = vec![1, 2];
|         - move occurs because `x` has type `Vec
`, which does not implement the `Copy` trait
3   |
4   |     for y in x {
|              - `x` moved due to this implicit call to `.into_iter()`
...
7   |     println!("{}", x.len());
|                    ^ value borrowed here after move
|
note: `into_iter` takes ownership of the receiver `self`, which moves `x`
--> /Users/ekr/.rustup/toolchains/stable-aarch64-apple-darwin/lib/rustlib/src/rust/library/core/src/iter/traits/collect.rs:346:18
|
346 |     fn into_iter(self) -> Self::IntoIter;
|                  ^^^^
help: consider iterating over a slice of the `Vec
`'s content to avoid moving into the `for` loop
|
4   |     for y in &x {
|              +
error: aborting due to 1 previous error
For more information about this error, try `rustc --explain E0382`.
make: *** [iter_into.out] Error 1
No joy! The error message is reasonably helpful, though:
note: `into_iter` takes ownership of the receiver `self`, which moves `x`
At a high level, here is what is happening.
The
for y in x
syntax tells Rust you want an iterator
In order to produce that iterator, Rust calls
x.into_iter()
, defined
by the trait
IntoIterator
which results in an iterator over
i32
.
The iterator
takes ownership
of the input vector
x
.
In the spirit of this series, though, let's dig one level deeper. You can ignore
the rest of this section if you don't really care about Rust details, but this
took me a little while to work out, so it's going up on the Internet.
The
for y in x
expression in Rust is
syntactic
sugar
for creating an iterator. The
x
value must implement the
IntoIterator
trait, which has the method
into_iter()
:
pub
trait
IntoIterator
{
type
Item
;
type
IntoIter
:
Iterator
<
Item
=
Self
::
Item
>
;
// Required method
fn
into_iter
(
self
)
->
Self
::
IntoIter
;
}
.into_iter()
returns an
Iterator
object which exposes a
.next()
method that returns the next value
in the iterator. You can loop over the iterator by calling
.next()
until it returns
None
(see
here
for some background on union types in Rust). For reference, here's what
the Rust reference says is the equivalent code to
for ...
:
{
let
result
=
match
IntoIterator
::
into_iter
(
iter_expr
)
{
mut
iter
=>
'label
:
loop
{
let
mut
next
;
match
Iterator
::
next
(
&
mut
iter
)
{
Option
::
Some
(
val
)
=>
next
=
val
,
Option
::
None
=>
break
,
}
;
let
PATTERN
=
next
;
let
(
)
=
{
/* loop body */
}
;
}
,
}
;
result
}
As the code above says, Rust implicitly calls
IntoIterator::into_iter(x)
,
which is to say it calls the
.into_iter()
method call for
x
(in this
case of type
Vec<i32>
, i.e.,
x.into_iter()
). The
IntoIterator::into_iter()
syntax is
needed in case
x
implements more than one trait that has an
into_iter()
method because we need to tell the Rust compiler which method to choose
(see below).
This syntactic sugar is all internal compiler magic, but from here on in the rest is normal
(though a bit arcane) Rust.
Function Overloads
#
So why does this result in a move and why does replacing
x
with
&x
fix it?
If you've done any Rust programming, you know that you can call a method that
takes any kind of
self
parameter (i.e., a moved object, a reference, or a mutable
reference) as
self.foo
and Rust will automatically produce the right kind of parameter
assuming your object is compatible in terms of mutability.
For instance:
Code
#
struct
X
{
}
impl
X
{
fn
ref_method
(
&
self
)
{
println!
(
"ref"
)
;
}
fn
mut_ref_method
(
&
mut
self
)
{
println!
(
"mut_ref"
)
;
}
fn
move_method
(
self
)
{
println!
(
"move"
)
;
}
}
fn
main
(
)
{
let
mut
x
=
X
{
}
;
let
mut
y
=
X
{
}
;
let
yref
=
&
mut
y
;
x
.
ref_method
(
)
;
x
.
mut_ref_method
(
)
;
x
.
move_method
(
)
;
// x.move_method();     Does not compile
yref
.
ref_method
(
)
;
yref
.
mut_ref_method
(
)
;
// yref.move_method();  Does not compile
(
&
y
)
.
ref_method
(
)
;
(
&
mut
y
)
.
mut_ref_method
(
)
;
}
Output
#
ref
mut_ref
move

data.title: DoorDash to acquire Deliveroo
data.author: mfiguiere
data.article_summary: 英国外卖公司Deliveroo同意了美国竞争对手DoorDash的收购提案，DoorDash将以每股180便士的价格收购Deliveroo全部已发行和将发行股票，交易对Deliveroo的估值为29亿英镑。这一价格较4月4日收盘价溢价44%。Deliveroo股价随后升至三年高点。DoorDash CEO表示，合并后将覆盖40多个国家、超10亿人口，助力本地企业发展。此次收购标志着Deliveroo动荡的上市公司生涯结束，其股价自2021年IPO以来已下跌超过50%。对DoorDash而言，收购Deliveroo是其海外扩展的重要一步，此前它已在2022年收购了芬兰外卖应用Wolt。食品外卖行业近年来持续整合，竞争激烈。

主要讨论点：外卖配送服务的优缺点及相关问题

不同观点：
• **反对外卖服务**：
  - SirMaster：食物常常变冷，有时还被偷，导致需要花费时间与配送员和客服交涉以获得退款。此外，服务费用几乎让原本昂贵的食物价格翻倍。
  - prmoustache：认为人们因为懒惰而使用配送服务，但代价是等待时间更长、食物变冷，且配送范围有限，不如自己去取餐。
  - antonyh：在伦敦，除了Dominoes外，其他服务都很差，包括配送错误、食物变冷、质量差和缺少物品。自己去取餐更快更好。
  - Havoc：除非有Amex折扣，否则不会使用Deliveroo。

• **支持传统用餐方式**：
  - gregorvand：新加坡的小贩中心是最好的系统，食物便宜、无需配送费和排放，还可以与人交流。

• **关注配送服务经济和市场动态**：
  - tnel77：指出邻居频繁使用配送服务，但自己宁愿直接打电话给餐厅以节省20-35%的费用。
  - FlyingSnake：提到DoorDash和披萨套利的经济文章，分析配送应用的经济模式。
  - macsparrow：讨论Deliveroo的市场表现，包括退出国际市场和失去本土市场份额。

• **关于配送服务技术和市场策略**：
  - voidUpdate：抱怨配送员总是找不到其公寓位置，尽管已经清楚标记。
  - morpheuskafka：指出Deliveroo香港业务被卖给Foodpanda，DoorDash只收购特定市场。

• **对垄断和资本主义的批评**：
  - Frieren：认为这些收购旨在减少竞争和创建垄断，批评资本主义下通过投资者资金购买垄断。

• **对欧洲市场影响的担忧**：
  - Argonaut998：担心欧洲市场被美国公司控制，质疑这些收购在当前环境下的批准。

补充讨论：
- ksynwa：希望这些应用能允许点外卖。
- modeless：只是提到Deliveroo名字更好。

争议焦点：
- 外卖服务的便利性与质量、费用的权衡。
- 配送服务的市场垄断与竞争问题。
- 技术和服务的实际执行问题，如配送员找地址的困难。

总的来说，讨论围绕外卖配送服务的优缺点、经济模式、市场动态以及技术和执行问题展开，存在对服务质量和费用的不满，以及对垄断和市场控制的批评。

Key Points
British food delivery firm Deliveroo said its board agreed to an offer from DoorDash to acquire all issued and to be issued shares in the company for 180 pence a share.
That marks a 44% premium to Deliveroo's closing price on April 4, the last business day prior to DoorDash's initial offer letter.
The transaction values Deliveroo at £2.9 billion on a fully diluted basis.

A Deliveroo rider near Victoria station in London, England, on March 31, 2021.
Dan Kitwood | Getty Images
LONDON — British food delivery firm
Deliveroo
on Tuesday said it has agreed to a takeover offer from American rival DoorDash that values the company at £2.9 billion ($3.9 billion).
Deliveroo, which lets users order hot meals and groceries via an app, said its board agreed to an offer from DoorDash to acquire all issued and to be issued shares in the company for 180 pence a share.
That marks a 44% premium to Deliveroo's closing price on April 4, the last business day prior to DoorDash's initial offer letter.
Deliveroo shares jumped to a
three-year high
last week after the company confirmed it had received a takeover offer from DoorDash.
The transaction values Deliveroo at £2.9 billion on a fully diluted basis, the company said.
DoorDash said that the financial terms of the acquisition were final and would not be increased unless a third party steps in with a rival bid.
"I could not be more excited by the prospect of what DoorDash and Deliveroo will be able to accomplish together. We'll cover more than 40 countries with a combined population of more than 1 billion people, enabling us to provide more local businesses with the tools and technology they need to thrive," said Tony Xu, CEO and Co-founder of DoorDash.
International expansion
The acquisition deal marks an end to Deliveroo's tumultuous ride as a public company.
Once viewed as a British tech darling, Deliveroo saw its shares tank 30% in 2021 in one of the worst trading debuts on the London Stock Exchange. Shares have continued to fall from that point and are down more than 50% from the firm's £3.90 IPO price.
Get a weekly round up of the top tech stories from around the world in your inbox every Friday.
Subscribe
Deliveroo went public at a time when the U.K. was still feeling the impacts of Covid-19 lockdowns, which had boosted the fortunes of various food delivery platforms. Investors questioned the sustainability of that growth in a post-Covid world, and saw intense competition in the market and legal challenges to the gig economy model as key risks for Deliveroo.
For DoorDash, acquiring Deliveroo marks a renewed effort from the American online takeout app to expand its presence overseas. DoorDash acquired Finnish food delivery app Wolt for 7 billion euros ($7.9 billion) in 2022.
More broadly, the food delivery sector has been undergoing consolidation for several years now. Earlier this year, Deliveroo
sold parts
of its Hong Kong unit to Delivery Hero, while
Just East
agreed to be acquired
by investment group Prosus.

  - gregorvand：新加坡的小贩中心是最好的系统，食物便宜、无需配送费和排放，还可以与人交流。

• **关注配送服务经济和市场动态**：
  - tnel77：指出邻居频繁使用配送服务，但自己宁愿直接打电话给餐厅以节省20-35%的费用。
  - FlyingSnake：提到DoorDash和披萨套利的经济文章，分析配送应用的经济模式。
  - macsparrow：讨论Deliveroo的市场表现，包括退出国际市场和失去本土市场份额。

• **关于配送服务技术和市场策略**：
  - voidUpdate：抱怨配送员总是找不到其公寓位置，尽管已经清楚标记。
  - morpheuskafka：指出Deliveroo香港业务被卖给Foodpanda，DoorDash只收购特定市场。

• **对垄断和资本主义的批评**：
  - Frieren：认为这些收购旨在减少竞争和创建垄断，批评资本主义下通过投资者资金购买垄断。

• **对欧洲市场影响的担忧**：
  - Argonaut998：担心欧洲市场被美国公司控制，质疑这些收购在当前环境下的批准。

补充讨论：
- ksynwa：希望这些应用能允许点外卖。
- modeless：只是提到Deliveroo名字更好。

争议焦点：
- 外卖服务的便利性与质量、费用的权衡。
- 配送服务的市场垄断与竞争问题。
- 技术和服务的实际执行问题，如配送员找地址的困难。

总的来说，讨论围绕外卖配送服务的优缺点、经济模式、市场动态以及技术和执行问题展开，存在对服务质量和费用的不满，以及对垄断和市场控制的批评。

data.author: nill0

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Curry-Howard correspondence及其在编程和证明书写中的应用和教学价值

不同观点：
• elikoga认为，将"Propositions as Types"（命题即类型）/ Curry-Howard correspondence应用于教学中，可以帮助学生更好地掌握结构化的证明书写技巧，尤其是在函数式编程教学中。他认为这种方法能够帮助学生更好地处理证明中的蕴涵和量化问题。
• devlovstad从个人经验出发，表示虽然选修的语义与类型课程（涉及Curry-Howard correspondence的概念）对他有很大帮助，特别是在精确书写证明和理解程序执行方面，但这种课程在计算机科学学生中并不受欢迎，尤其是在人工智能热门的情况下。他还提到了一次对Phil Wadler演讲的失望经历。
• indyjo认为Curry-Howard correspondence被过度宣传为对程序员有用，但实际上它的应用范围有限，尤其是在主流编程语言中。他指出，虽然该理论在纯函数式编程语言中有用，但在命令式、状态化、并发等更常见的编程范式中应用难度大。他希望有更多努力将强大的形式化方法引入主流编程语言或开发更实用的编程语言。
• marcusb提供了另一个相关演讲的链接，供进一步了解Curry-Howard correspondence。
• js8推荐了一本关于Curry-Howard correspondence的书，强调了其在逻辑和类型关系方面的解释。
• gitroom表示，虽然在代码中进行正式证明能帮助捕捉错误，但实际操作中往往比直接修复问题更慢。
• aatd86建议进一步探讨集合论及其对类型的解释，以丰富对Curry-Howard correspondence的理解。
• emorning3表示不愿意手动证明代码正确性，而是希望通过逻辑规范自动生成代码，并询问是否有类似Prolog的工具。
• immibis认为Curry-Howard correspondence虽然有趣，但在实际编程中并不特别有用。他指出，很多对应命题的类型和程序并不能带来实际编程中的洞见，类似于将逻辑表达式转换为集合运算，只是符号不同，并无实质性新见解。

补充讨论：
• 讨论中涉及了对Curry-Howard correspondence在教育中的潜在价值的不同看法，有些人认为它对学生有帮助，而另一些人则认为它的实际应用有限。
• 对主流编程语言中引入形式化方法的期望和挑战也被提及，特别是在实用性和接受度方面。
• 一些参与者分享了个人学习经验和对相关资源的推荐，提供了进一步了解该主题的途径。
• 争议的焦点在于Curry-Howard correspondence的实际应用价值，尤其是在编程实践中的效用。

data.title: Cuttlefish 'talk' with their arms, study reveals
data.author: geox
data.article_summary: 科学家发现乌贼通过独特的腕部动作进行交流，这些被称为“腕波信号”的动作包括“向上”、“侧面”、“翻滚”和“皇冠”四种姿态，每种姿态涉及不同的腕部位置和波动模式，常伴有体色变化。研究显示，这些信号可以通过视觉和水中振动被感知，形成多感官交流系统。乌贼对正放的视频信号反应更强烈，且能区分原始信号和被扰乱的信号。该发现揭示了乌贼复杂的交流方式，可能涉及侧线和平衡囊等感知水运动的器官，为进一步理解海洋无脊椎动物的交流提供了新视角。

43904478.article_content:
ig. 1. Four distinct arm wave signs observed in adult Sepia officinalis (A–D) and juvenile Sepia bandensis (E–H):
“Up” sign (A, E): The most frequently displayed gesture, characterized by upward extension of the first arm pair and outward extension of the fourth pair, while the second and third arm pairs are twisted at the midsection.
“Side” sign (B, F): All arms are rolled to one side of the body, creating a lateral display.
“Roll” sign (C, G): All arms are tucked and rolled beneath the head, altering its shape to highlight the eyes.
“Crown” sign (D, H): Features a rapid “spitting” motion, with arms arranged in a crown-like formation.
Scientists have discovered that cuttlefish use distinct arm movements to communicate with each other, adding another dimension to these already remarkable marine creatures.
Researchers from the École Normale Supérieure in Paris and the Italian Institute of Technology have identified specific arm gestures they’ve named “arm wave signs” that appear to serve as a communication system between cuttlefish. The study, published this month in bioRxiv, reveals that these underwater signals can be perceived both visually and through water vibrations – essentially creating a multi-sensory conversation.
According to the researchers, this newly discovered behavior involves distinct arm movements that follow specific patterns in two cuttlefish species. These arm wave signs involve deliberate, expressive arm undulations that can last several seconds and be combined in various sequences.
The research team, led by Sophie Cohen-Bodénès and Peter Neri, documented these movements over months of observation. They identified four distinct gestures they named “up,” “side,” “roll,” and “crown” signs. Each movement involves different arm positions and undulating motions, often combined with color changes on the cuttlefish’s skin.
What makes this discovery particularly intriguing is that the cuttlefish responded differently to these signals depending on their orientation. When shown videos of other cuttlefish performing these arm waves, the animals were significantly more likely to “wave back” when the video was displayed right-side up versus upside-down – similar to how humans perceive faces and other socially relevant displays.
But perhaps most surprisingly, the researchers found evidence that these arm motions might be perceived not just visually but also through vibrations in the water. Using specially designed playback experiments, they recorded the mechanical waves produced by these arm movements and played them back to test subjects.
The researchers found that these signals work through multiple sensory channels. By using specialized playback experiments, they demonstrated that cuttlefish can perceive these communications both visually and through water movement detection.
The cuttlefish were more responsive to the original recordings compared to versions that were played backward or scrambled – suggesting they could detect meaningful information in these water movements.
This dual-channel communication system might utilize the cuttlefish’s lateral line and statocysts, sensory organs that detect water movement and low-frequency vibrations. These findings suggest an intriguing parallel between cephalopod communication and the audiovisual communication seen in vertebrates – despite evolving independently.
The team points to fascinating evolutionary parallels, suggesting that just as cephalopods independently evolved camera-like eyes similar to vertebrates, their sensory systems for detecting water movement may have evolved to serve communication functions similar to vertebrate hearing.
The exact meaning behind these arm signs remains unclear. The researchers observed them in various contexts – during mating, hunting, defensive situations, and sometimes spontaneously. This suggests the signs might serve multiple purposes depending on the situation.
The discovery opens new avenues for understanding communication in marine invertebrates and adds to our appreciation of cephalopod intelligence. These surprisingly sophisticated “conversations” taking place beneath the waves highlight how much we still have to learn about communication in the animal kingdom.
Looking ahead, the research team hopes to explore how this discovery might provide insights into communication between vastly different animal species, potentially opening new pathways for understanding how diverse creatures interact with their environment.

data.title: Curl: We still have not seen a valid security report done with AI help
data.author: indigodaddy
data.article_summary: Daniel Stenberg, CEO of curl, 表达了对HackerOne平台上大量低质量AI生成的安全报告的不满。他宣布，将要求每个提交报告的人说明是否使用了AI生成报告，并对被认为是AI粗制滥造的报告提交者立即封禁。Stenberg提到，他们尚未看到任何有效的AI辅助安全报告，且这种现象已接近DDoS攻击的程度。他考虑过通过要求提交者支付保证金来提高报告质量，并对AI生成垃圾报告进行过滤。其他用户也提出了类似的担忧和建议，如建立全球黑名单或白名单，以及利用GPT管道处理报告等。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：AI生成内容对漏洞报告质量和安全研究工作的影响

不同观点：
• **danielvf**：认为当前的LLM（大型语言模型）生成的漏洞报告大多是无效的，且用户会反复使用LLM处理反馈，导致生成更无意义的内容。他质疑人们是否能区分有效信息和垃圾信息，并认为AI工具目前还不能有效用于安全研究。

• **bogwog**：提出恶意使用AI生成大量无效报告可能会成为一种攻击手段，目的是通过DDOS方式掩盖真实漏洞，从而减少被发现的可能性。

• **vessenes**：认为AI正在改变这一领域的经济模式，并提出建立声誉系统以区分高质量报告和垃圾报告。通过给予通过身份验证的用户更多权限，鼓励他们提交有效报告。

• **parliament32**：同意AI生成的报告多为无稽之谈，并指出一些具体例子，如报告中的函数名根本不存在，批评这些报告未经核实。

• **kazinator**：建议对报告者收取可退还的押金，以减少无效报告的数量。如果报告是真实的或诚实错误，押金将退还；如果是无效的，则不退还。

• **rdtsc**：引用报告中的例子，指出报告者在报告中表明自己开放就业，讽刺他们使用AI生成垃圾报告的行为。

• **uludag**：指出LLM在处理代码安全漏洞时，往往会编造不存在的信息，认为这是系统对齐问题，限制了这些工具的有效性。

• **jacksnipe**：批评那些依赖AI工具的人，常常直接引用AI的回复而不加以理解，认为这种行为毫无帮助。

• **meindnoch**：提出简单解决方案，要求报告者在提交安全报告前支付小额押金，如果报告被认为是AI生成的垃圾，则押金归审查者所有。

• **ianbutler**：提出反例，指出其团队使用AI工具成功发现有效漏洞，并认为问题在于使用者背景和工具调校，而非工具本身。

• **prettyblocks**：质疑如果有人使用AI发现了有效安全问题并成功报告，如何判断AI是否参与其中，认为不应简单否定AI的潜力。

补充讨论：
• 对LinkedIn访问的讨论（molticrystal）：提到对替代界面的需求，以避免登录访问LinkedIn内容，并分享了相关帖子内容。

争议焦点：
• AI生成内容对安全研究的影响：一方面认为AI生成大量无效报告，严重干扰正常工作；另一方面认为AI工具若正确使用，可以发现有效漏洞。
• 如何有效筛选和激励高质量报告：提出押金制度、声誉系统等不同解决方案，以应对AI生成垃圾报告的问题。

总结：评论主要围绕AI生成报告的有效性和其对安全研究工作的影响展开讨论，争议点在于如何平衡AI工具的潜力和其带来的问题。

data.title: Is Planet Nine Alone in the Outer System?
data.author: JPLeRouzic
data.article_summary:
文章探讨了假设存在的第九行星及其在太阳系外围的探索潜力。作者引用Robert Browning的名言，引出人类探索太空边界的渴望，并提到目前对太阳引力透镜距离（约550 AU）的探索。尽管这一目标超出当前技术能力，但JPL的团队正在进行相关任务设计。文章指出，寻找如第九行星这样的新目标可能激发更多探索兴趣，尤其是如果它类似于在其他星系中发现的超级地球或迷你海王星。

研究显示，许多恒星系统存在超级地球，这支持了第九行星存在的可能性。其质量预计为地球的10倍以上，半长轴约700 AU。尽管光学调查未能发现，但通过比较IRAS和AKARI卫星23年间的数据，研究团队尝试寻找可能的红外源，以确认第九行星的存在。文章强调，尽管技术挑战大，但发现新行星将极大推动太空探索。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：太阳系外围异常轨道成因的解释及假设行星的存在

不同观点：
• adrian_b认为，许多跨海王星天体的奇异轨道并不能直接证明目前在海王星之外存在一个巨大的行星。他认为，这仅表明过去曾有一个大质量天体（可能是一颗经过的恒星）扰动了这些轨道，并引用了2024年发表的相关论文支持其观点。
• Qem提到了Brown的观点，即现有观测到的某些天体不太可能是假定的第九行星，因为其轨道倾斜度与预测不符。同时，Qem还提到了Lykawka和Mukai提出的独立假设，认为可能存在另一个未被发现的大质量天体，与Batygin和Brown提出的第九行星假设不同。
• yellowapple的观点更多是对冥王星降级的情感反应，并幽默地表达了对不能将假定的跨冥王星天体称为"X行星"的失望。

补充讨论：
• rdtsc提供了之前讨论的链接和一个相关论文的链接，但未提出新的论点。
• p0w3n3d和WalterBright以幽默方式回应，没有提出实质性观点。
• glimshe抱怨网站劫持滚动条，属于技术问题，与讨论主题无关。
• codethief指出了原文中未标明来源的问题，并提供了Mike Brown相关帖子的链接。
• xhrpost进行了技术性讨论，计算了使用Dark Energy Camera进行后续观测的可能分辨率。
• ArthurStacks认为这个话题已经讨论了几十年，但没有提出新的论据。
• soufron询问了关于过去某恒星经过的 proposed timeline。
• RajT88和eth0up以幽默方式表达了对假定行星形状和大小的猜测。
• cratermoon重申了冥王星是最大的跨海王星天体之一的观点。
• Hobadee以幽默方式坚持认为第九行星就是冥王星。

争议焦点：
• 主要争议在于太阳系外围异常轨道的成因：是一颗过去经过的恒星（adrian_b的观点）还是一个未被发现的大质量天体（Qem引用的Lykawka和Mukai的观点），亦或是广泛讨论的第九行星假设（Brown等人的观点）。
• 冥王星的地位问题再次被幽默地提及（Hobadee的观点），但并非严肃的科学讨论。

43907586.article_content:
Is Planet Nine Alone in the Outer System?
by
Paul Gilster
|
May 6, 2025
|
Outer Solar System
|
2 comments
It was Robert Browning who said “Ah, but a man’s reach should exceed his grasp, or what’s a heaven for?” A rousing thought, but we don’t always know where we should reach. In terms of space exploration, a distant but feasible target is the solar gravitational lens distance beginning around 550 AU. So far the SGL definitely exceeds our grasp, but solid work in mission design by Slava Turyshev and team is ongoing at the Jet Propulsion Laboratory.
Targets need to tantalize, and maybe a target that we hadn’t previously considered is now emerging. Planet Nine, the hypothesized world that may lurk somewhere in our Solar System’s outer reaches, would be such an extraordinary discovery that it would tempt future mission designers in the same way.
This is interesting because right now our deep space targets need to be well defined. I love the idea of
Interstellar Probe
, the craft designed at JHU/APL, but it’s hard to excite the public with the idea of looking back at the heliosphere from the outside (although the science return would be fabulous). Pluto was hard enough to sell to the powers that be, but Allen Stern and team got the job done because they had a whole world that had never been seen up close. Will Planet Nine, if found, turn out to be the destination that some budget-strapped team finds a way to explore?
We have a lot to learn about planetary demographics given that our planet-finding technologies work best for larger worlds closer in to their stars. But a recent microlensing study suggests that as many as one out of every three stars in our galaxy should host a super-Earth in a Jupiter-like orbit (citation below). Microlensing is helpful because it can reveal planets at large distances from their parent stars. Super-Earths appear to be abundant. If it exists, Planet Nine isn’t in a Jovian orbit, but it’s probably smaller than Neptune.
In so many ways this planet makes sense. We’ve found planets like it in innumerable stellar systems. We also know that mechanisms of gravitational slingshotting can push a planet either out of its system entirely or into an entirely new orbit, explaining our prior lack of detection. We’re talking about a planet on the order of a super-Earth or a mini-Neptune, the former larger than our planet but still rocky, the latter smaller than Neptune but gaseous.
Image:
An illustration shows what Planet Nine might look like orbiting far from our Sun. We have found many such worlds around other stars, but finding one in our own backyard is taking time because of its distance and an orbit that is probably well off the ecliptic. Assuming a planet is there at all. Image credit: NASA/Caltech.
The evidence in the orbits of a number of outer system objects points to something perturbing their paths, and seems to implicate something big. Now we have, after years of evidence gathering and debate, at least a possible candidate for this world. In process at
Publications of the Astronomical Society of Australia (PASA)
, although not yet published, the paper digs deep into data from the Infrared Astronomical Satellite as well as AKARI, a Japanese satellite somewhat more sensitive than IRAS and launched in 2006.
The distant Sedna and other similar bodies with unusual orbital characteristics tell us that something has to account for their high eccentricity and inclination, while a number of Kuiper Belt objects seem to be similarly affected, as shown in the orientation of their orbits (described through what is known as the
argument of perihelion
). Computations thus far indicate mass on the order of something equal to or greater than 10 Earth masses, with a semi-major axis of about 700 AU.
Image:
The six most distant known objects in the solar system with orbits exclusively beyond Neptune (magenta) all mysteriously line up in a single direction. Moreover, when viewed in 3-D, the orbits of all these icy little objects are tilted in the same direction, away from the plane of the solar system. PL-Caltech/R. Hurt.
A huge amount of work has gone into this analysis, all ably summarized in the paper, which comes from Terry Long Phan (National Tsing Hua University, Taiwan) and colleagues. Optical surveys have heretofore failed to find this object, but 700 AU is fully 23 times the distance of Neptune from the Sun, far enough out that visible wavelengths need to give way to infrared to find it.
Phan’s team looked for candidate objects in the range of 500 to 700 AU using the two far-infrared surveys mentioned above, which are both all-sky in range but separated by 23 years, making for useful comparisons. The idea was to find an object that moved from an IRAS position to an AKARI position after those 23 years. Assuming the kind of mass and distance they were looking for, they had to remove stars and noisy sources toward galactic center. Narrowing the field to 13 pairings, Phan and his doctoral advisor T

data.title: Show HN: Reverse Pac-Man
data.author: Eagle64
data.article_summary:
"Reverse Pac-Man"是一款与经典《吃豆人》玩法相反的游戏。玩家控制幽灵去捕捉Pac-Man，而非传统中Pac-Man吃豆并躲避幽灵。具体操作如下：  
- 红色幽灵（Ghost 1）：使用WASD或ZQSD键控制移动。  
- 青色幽灵（Ghost 2）：使用方向键控制移动。  

游戏通过反转角色控制，带来新的挑战和乐趣。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对一款类似Pac-Man游戏的机制、设计和技术问题的讨论

不同观点：
• [tantalor] 认为游戏中改变方向的机制过于严格，建议允许玩家按住键提前改变方向，而不是在到达路口时才检测按键，这样可以提高游戏的可玩性。
• [kazinator] 支持tantalor的部分观点，指出幽灵只有在遇到路口时才会响应按键，虽然这可能是故意设置的，但仍然让人感到烦恼。

补充讨论：
• [staticman2] 提到了任天堂的“Pac-Man Vs”模式，其中幽灵玩家无法看到完整地图，而Pac-Man玩家通过Game Boy Advanced链接可以看到，这种多玩家机制增加了游戏的趣味性。
• [KennedyHere] 对游戏标题与其实际玩法之间的预期差异提出了幽默的评论，原本期待引导Pac-Man重新排列点，但发现游戏本身很有趣。
• [amadeuspagel] 赞赏游戏中使用不同键位控制两个角色的创意，并建议通过颜色区分说明文字以提升用户体验。
• [pmontra] 表达了对这种创新玩法的赞赏，认为这种设计新颖且具有吸引力。
• [narcindin] 提到了一款十年前类似机制的游戏“swap box turbo”，该游戏也设计了双人玩法并可在单人模式下体验类似的玩法。
• [bentcorner] 推荐了另一款采用双控制机制的游戏“Brothers: A Tale of Two Sons”，并认为其围绕双人控制设计的谜题非常有趣。

技术问题与建议：
• [xnx] 建议增加双摇杆控制器支持，以提升游戏体验，并提供了相关的开发者文档链接。
• [adamiscool8] 对计分机制提出了疑问，认为分数是否应该倒计时，或者玩家是否应尽可能多地引导Pac-Man吃掉更多物品以获得高分。

data.title: iOS Kindle app now has a ‘get book’ button after changes to App Store rules
data.author: diversion
data.article_summary: Amazon has updated its Kindle iOS app to include a "Get Book" button, allowing users to purchase ebooks directly from the app. This change comes after a recent ruling in the Epic Games v. Apple case, which prevents Apple from collecting a 27% commission on purchases made outside of apps or restricting alternative payment methods. Previously, due to Apple's policies, users had to purchase ebooks through a web browser and then sync them to the app. The new "Get Book" button redirects users to complete purchases via a mobile web browser, streamlining the process. However, if Apple wins its appeal, Amazon may need to revert these changes.
data.comments_summary:

不同观点：

• **对独立开发者的担忧**：[LeicaLatte] 指出，虽然规则在纸面上改变了，但Apple的算法仍可能通过调整搜索排名影响独立开发者的应用可见性，特别是对于没有客户支持的ASO（应用商店优化）渠道，独立开发者可能面临更大风险。

43909432.article_content:
News
Amazon now has a ‘Get book’ button in its iOS Kindle app
Amazon has updated its Kindle iOS app to take advantage of recent changes to Apple’s App Store rules.
Amazon has updated its Kindle iOS app to take advantage of recent changes to Apple’s App Store rules.
by
Andrew Liszewski
May 6, 2025, 1:00 PM UTC
Link
Facebook
Threads
The Kindle iOS mobile app now includes a Get Book button for purchasing ebooks.
Screenshot: Amazon
Andrew Liszewski
is a senior reporter who’s been covering and reviewing the latest gadgets and tech since 2011, but has loved all things electronic since he was a kid.
Following a
ruling on April 30th
by the
Epic Games v. Apple
judge Yvonne Gonzalez Rogers, Apple can no longer collect a 27 percent commission on purchases made outside of apps or restrict how developers can direct users to alternate payment options. Apple has
appealed the decision
, but is also complying with it in the interim, prompting several companies to
announce app updates
making it
easier for users to pay for subscriptions and services
. That now includes Amazon’s iOS Kindle app. Contrary to prior limitations, there is now a prominent orange “Get book” button on Kindle app’s book listings.
“We regularly make improvements to our apps to help ensure we are providing customers the most convenient experience possible,” Amazon spokesperson Tim Gillman told
The Verge
over email. “By selecting ‘Get Book’ within the Kindle for iOS app, customers can now complete their purchase through their mobile web browser.”
Amazon wasn’t the first company to release a dedicated reading device with an E Ink screen. Companies like Sony beat them to the punch by a couple of years. What helped make the Kindle popular, and arguably destined to dominate the e-reader market, was that you could buy books right on the device, even if you didn’t have Wi-Fi access thanks to
Amazon’s now discontinued cellular Whispernet
service.
Before today’s updates, buying books wasn’t a feature you’d find in the Kindle mobile app following app store rule changes Apple implemented in 2011 that required developers to remove links or buttons leading to alternate ways to make purchases. You could
search for books that offered samples
for download, add them to a shopping list, and read titles you already own, but you couldn’t actually buy titles through the Kindle or Amazon app, or even see their prices.
To avoid having to pay Apple’s 30 percent cut of in-app purchases, and the
27 percent tax on alternative payment methods
Apple introduced in January 2024, Amazon previously required you to visit and login to its online store through a device’s web browser to purchase ebooks on your iPhone or iPad, which were then synchronized to the app. It was a cumbersome process compared to the streamlined experience of buying ebooks directly on a Kindle e-reader.
Amazon probably isn’t going to change its mind about avoiding Apple’s 30 percent cut on ebook sales, but the update to the Kindle app now makes it much easier to purchase ebooks on your iPhone for those times when your Kindle e-reader doesn’t have a reliable Wi-Fi connection.
However, there’s still the chance Apple could win its appeal, forcing Amazon to undo these updates and improvements and once again make buying ebooks on iPhones overcomplicated and inconvenient.

data.title: Brush (Bo(u)rn(e) RUsty SHell) a POSIX and Bash-Compatible Shell in Rust
data.author: voxadam
data.article_summary: **Brush** 是一个用 Rust 实现的兼容 POSIX 和 bash 的 shell，支持 Linux 和 macOS，并通过 WSL 在 Windows 上实验性运行。它功能齐全，可作为日常使用的交互式 shell，能执行大多数 sh 和 bash 脚本，但存在一些已知的兼容性限制，如部分 `set` 和 `shopt` 选项未完全实现。目前不建议在生产环境中使用，但欢迎贡献和反馈。安装方式包括通过 `cargo install` 或 Nix、Arch Linux 的 AUR 进行安装。项目采用 MIT 许可，主要通过与现有 shell 对比进行测试，拥有 550+ 个测试案例。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：各种Unix shell的比较与评价，重点讨论了兼容性、性能、实现语言以及许可证问题。

不同观点：
• **POSIX/Bash兼容性重要性**：[chubot]认为OSH是目前最兼容POSIX和bash的shell，并列举了多个理由和测试链接，强调其兼容性与性能优势。而[d4mi3n]和[Pet_Ant]则更关注于探索超越POSIX的shell，如Nushell和Fish，这些shell不追求POSIX兼容性，但提供更结构化的数据处理方式。

• **性能与实现语言**：[chubot]提到OSH使用了一种独特的实现方式，通过"executable spec"和C++加速，性能优于bash。而[ris]则质疑Rust实现的shell在体积上的问题，并提到需要通过多调用二进制文件来解决。

• **许可证问题**：[wiz21c]关注到Rust重写的项目通常使用更宽松的许可证（如MIT），相比GPL许可证的bash，这可能对自由软件社区产生影响。

• **实际使用中的问题**：[Muromec]提到OSH在和fzf脚本配合时存在问题，而[koakuma-chan]则对如何在Windows上运行这些shell存在疑问。

补充讨论：
• **其他Rust实现的shell**：[nbenitezl]推荐了wezterm，一个用Rust写的终端模拟器，而非传统shell。[mystified5016]提到BRASH也是一个Rust实现的shell选项。[shiomiru]提到另一个Rust写的POSIX shell，nsh，但其开发似乎已停滞。

• **个人偏好与使用动机**：[ohroy]表示虽然项目看起来不错，但找不到使用它的理由，反映了一些用户在选择shell时的困惑。[cryptonector]则简单表达了对新项目的喜悦。

争议焦点：
• **POSIX兼容性与创新**：一些用户如[chubot]重视POSIX和bash兼容性，而[d4mi3n]和[Pet_Ant]则认为应该探索更多非POSIX兼容的shell，以利用现代编程语言和数据处理方式的优势。

• **性能与体积的权衡**：[ris]质疑Rust实现的shell在体积上的劣势，而[chubot]则强调其性能优势，这是两种不同的关注点。

• **许可证的选择**：[wiz21c]对Rust项目使用更宽松的许可证表示担忧，认为这可能影响自由软件的自由度。

通过以上分析，可以看到用户在选择和评价shell时，主要关注兼容性、性能、实现语言和许可证等方面的问题，同时也反映出个人偏好和具体使用场景对选择的影响。

data.title: Will supercapacitors come to AI's rescue?
data.author: mfiguiere
data.article_summary: 文章讨论了人工智能（AI）工作负载对电力需求的快速波动可能对电网造成压力，尤其是在需要短时高功率的情况下。为解决这一问题，数据中心正引入超级电容器组。超级电容器能够快速充放电，适合应对AI计算中突发的电力需求高峰，从而减轻对电网的负担。这一方案由西门子能源等公司推动，旨在提升数据中心电力系统的稳定性和效率。文章强调，超级电容器可能成为应对AI电力挑战的关键解决方案。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：如何解决AI工作负载带来的电力需求波动问题，尤其是瞬时能量峰值对电网的影响及相关技术解决方案。

不同观点：
• **提高电压以增加能量密度**：krunck提到通过提高电容的电压来增加能量密度，并引用了能量存储公式E = (CV^2)/2，强调电压对能量存储的重要性。
• **虚拟计算和能源浪费**：tzs担心在无峰值期间进行虚拟计算以平滑需求会导致不必要的能源浪费，并讽刺可能有人结合LLM和加密货币挖掘来利用这种方法。
• **备用电源和电池退化问题**：0cf8612b2e1e提出使用备用电源和电池来应对电力需求，但指出锂电池在快速充放电过程中会退化，不过认为工业设施可以通过适当的冷却和容量管理来减缓退化。
• **GPU负载变化的原因**：blt对AI工作负载中的需求爆发感到困惑，认为AI训练应是持续的小批量处理，而非产生大量能量峰值。
• **使用软件优化运行**：Merrill建议通过软件和网络调整使GPU持续以最佳使用率运行，以避免GPU在计算间隙闲置。

补充讨论：
• **电网承受能力**：Animats质疑大数据中心的负载变化是否真的对电网构成问题，指出其他如电炉和轧机等间歇性负载更大。
• **负载曲线和次级工作负载**：janalsncm好奇这些集群的负载曲线，并建议如果“网络间隙”足够长，可以安排次级工作负载。
• **法律和合同义务**：rini17提到在欧洲，大客户可能有合同义务不对电网造成影响，质疑在美国是否也是如此。
• **冷却技术**：bcoates质疑数据中心是否完全被动冷却，并建议调节压缩机电机可能更便宜。
• **超级电容器和超导体的讨论**：paulkrush和amelius分别提出超级电容器和超导超级电感器作为潜在解决方案，但gitroom对此类技术fix持怀疑态度，认为更多是软件优化问题。

争议焦点：
• **硬件解决方案 vs 软件优化**：一部分评论者如0cf8612b2e1e和bcoates关注硬件层面的解决方案，如电池和冷却技术；而Merrill和WatchDog则认为通过软件调整来优化GPU使用是更直接和经济的途径。
• **电网影响的真实性**：Animats对大数据中心负载变化是否真的对电网构成显著影响持怀疑态度，而rini17则从法律和合同角度讨论了这一问题。

整体上，讨论围绕如何通过技术和管理手段有效应对AI计算中的电力需求波动问题，涉及硬件、软件及法律合规等多方面因素。

data.title: ACE-Step: A step towards music generation foundation model
data.author: wertyk
data.article_summary: ACE-Step是一个开源的音乐生成基础模型，旨在克服现有方法在生成速度、音乐连贯性和可控性方面的不足。它结合了扩散生成模型与Sana的深度压缩自动编码器（DCAE）以及轻量级线性Transformer，实现了快速且高质量的音乐生成。该模型能够在A100 GPU上20秒内生成4分钟的音乐，比基于LLM的模型快15倍，同时保持较高的音乐连贯性和歌词对齐。ACE-Step支持多种音乐风格、19种语言以及多种乐器和声乐技巧，并提供诸如声音克隆、歌词编辑、混音和音轨生成等高级控制功能。其目标是成为音乐AI的基石模型，类似于图像生成领域的Stable Diffusion。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：AI在音乐创作中的应用及其潜力和局限

不同观点：
• everdrive认为AI应该尽可能地破坏和重建一切，包括音乐，并且认为技术开发者无需对大众如何使用技术负责。这种观点带有一种技术决定论和商业利益优先的态度。
• Rodeoclash作为音乐人，期待AI能作为辅助工具，帮助填充和完善音乐作品，而不是完全生成整首歌曲。他提到AI在音效调整和MIDI生成方面的潜力，但对其在歌唱合成上的表现有所保留。
• 999900000999提到AI在特定音乐类型（如说唱）生成中的表现，指出AI在表达多样性和避免冒犯方面的局限，认为这限制了AI作为艺术创作工具的潜力。
• Semaphor对AI生成音乐的期望与实际结果不符，指出AI在生成特定音乐风格（如黑金属）时表现不佳，结果过于普通和泛化。
• briga关注AI音乐模型的训练数据来源，指出讨论中缺乏对数据收集和使用细节的透明度。
• l72希望AI能作为乐器演奏的辅助工具，而不是歌曲生成的主体，表达了对多样化音乐表现形式的期待。
• gitroom对AI在艺术创作中过于保守表示担忧，认为这可能限制了艺术的创新和发展。
• Alex_001对AI模型在音乐结构和整体 coherence上的表现提出疑问，比较了不同AI音乐生成工具的性能。
• montag对实验部分表示兴趣，引用了一个实验片段。
• architectonic比较了不同AI音乐生成工具的质量和提示 adherence。
• lilcrise关注AI音乐生成工具在小型VPS服务器上的运行可行性。
• dheera对AI音乐生成过程中的技术细节和模型架构提出详细问题，希望有更清晰的图示和解释。
• hammock询问是否有可访问的演示。
• frankfrank13简单表示对工具的玩耍性感到有趣。

补充讨论：
• AI在音乐创作中的角色：是从属工具还是主创作工具。
• AI生成音乐的多样性和避免冒犯的平衡。
• AI模型在特定音乐风格生成上的表现和局限。
• AI音乐生成工具的技术细节和运行可行性。
• 训练数据的来源和使用透明度。

争议焦点：
• AI生成音乐是否应完全取代人类创作，还是应作为辅助工具。
• AI在艺术创作中如何平衡创新和避免冒犯。
• 技术开发者对AI技术被滥用的责任问题。

🏗️ Architecture
📝 Abstract
We introduce ACE-Step, a novel open-source foundation model for music generation that overcomes key limitations of existing approaches and achieves state-of-the-art performance through a holistic architectural design. Current methods face inherent trade-offs between generation speed, musical coherence, and controllability. For instance, LLM-based models (e.g., Yue, SongGen) excel at lyric alignment but suffer from slow inference and structural artifacts. Diffusion models (e.g., DiffRhythm), on the other hand, enable faster synthesis but often lack long-range structural coherence.
ACE-Step bridges this gap by integrating diffusion-based generation with Sana’s Deep Compression AutoEncoder (DCAE) and a lightweight linear transformer. It further leverages MERT and m-hubert to align semantic representations (REPA) during training, enabling rapid convergence. As a result, our model synthesizes up to 4 minutes of music in just 20 seconds on an A100 GPU—15× faster than LLM-based baselines—while achieving superior musical coherence and lyric alignment across melody, harmony, and rhythm metrics. Moreover, ACE-Step preserves fine-grained acoustic details, enabling advanced control mechanisms such as voice cloning, lyric editing, remixing, and track generation (e.g., lyric2vocal, singing2accompaniment).
Rather than building yet another end-to-end text-to-music pipeline, our vision is to establish a foundation model for music AI: a fast, general-purpose, efficient yet flexible architecture that makes it easy to train sub-tasks on top of it. This paves the way for developing powerful tools that seamlessly integrate into the creative workflows of music artists, producers, and content creators. In short, we aim to build the Stable Diffusion moment for music.
✨ Features
🎯 Baseline Quality
🌈 Diverse Styles & Genres
🎸 Supports all mainstream music styles with various description formats including short tags, descriptive text, or use-case scenarios
🎷 Capable of generating music across different genres with appropriate instrumentation and style
🌍 Multiple Languages
🗣️ Supports 19 languages with top 10 well-performing languages including:
🇺🇸 English, 🇨🇳 Chinese, 🇷🇺 Russian, 🇪🇸 Spanish, 🇯🇵 Japanese, 🇩🇪 German, 🇫🇷 French, 🇵🇹 Portuguese, 🇮🇹 Italian, 🇰🇷 Korean
⚠️
Due to data imbalance, less common languages may underperform
🎻 Instrumental Styles
🎹 Supports various instrumental music generation across different genres and styles
🎺 Capable of producing realistic instrumental tracks with appropriate timbre and expression for each instrument
🎼 Can generate complex arrangements with multiple instruments while maintaining musical coherence
🎤 Vocal Techniques
🎙️ Capable of rendering various vocal styles and techniques with good quality
🗣️ Supports different vocal expressions including various singing techniques and styles
🎛️ Controllability
🔄 Variations Generation
⚙️ Implemented using training-free, inference-time optimization techniques
🌊 Flow-matching model generates initial noise, then uses trigFlow's noise formula to add additional Gaussian noise
🎚️ Adjustable mixing ratio between original initial noise and new Gaussian noise to control variation degree
🎨 Repainting
🖌️ Implemented by adding noise to the target audio input and applying mask constraints during the ODE process
🔍 When input conditions change from the original generation, only specific aspects can be modified while preserving the rest
🔀 Can be combined with Variations Generation techniques to create localized variations in style, lyrics, or vocals

43909398.article_summary: ACE-Step是一个开源的音乐生成基础模型，旨在克服现有方法在生成速度、音乐连贯性和可控性方面的不足。它结合了扩散生成模型与Sana的深度压缩自动编码器（DCAE）以及轻量级线性Transformer，实现了快速且高质量的音乐生成。该模型能够在A100 GPU上20秒内生成4分钟的音乐，比基于LLM的模型快15倍，同时保持较高的音乐连贯性和歌词对齐。ACE-Step支持多种音乐风格、19种语言以及多种乐器和声乐技巧，并提供诸如声音克隆、歌词编辑、混音和音轨生成等高级控制功能。其目标是成为音乐AI的基石模型，类似于图像生成领域的Stable Diffusion。

data.author: kristianp
data.article_summary:
本文讨论了软件膨胀（bloat）仍然是软件最大的漏洞问题。作者Daniel Zender回顾了1995年Niklaus Wirth提出的“精简软件”的呼吁，并指出近30年后情况仍未改善。现代软件往往包含数百万行代码和大量未知来源的外部库，导致安全问题频发，甚至大型科技公司也犯下基本的安全错误。

文章强调软件安全形势严峻，建议通过立法（如欧盟的NIS2、网络弹性法案和产品责任指令）来提升软件质量。作者分析了当前问题 partly 源于经济激励，因为快速推出不安全软件能节省时间和成本。最后，作者分享了自己编写简约但现代软件的实践，呼吁业内人士共同改善现状。

总之，软件确实变得异常复杂和危险，需要更多关注和改进。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：软件依赖管理、代码臃肿（bloat）及其对开发和安全的影响

不同观点：
• GuB-42认为，C/C++中传统的依赖管理不便反而可能是件好事。虽然现代包管理工具如npm、Maven、Cargo非常方便，但容易导致引入大量未知来源的包和代码，最终代码库变得难以管理。而C的传统方式迫使开发者慎重考虑每个库，甚至自己实现功能，从而保持代码的简洁。
  
• dvh指出，代码臃肿往往体现在过度的间接层次上。简单的修改（如按钮颜色）可能需要修改多个文件和模块，导致开发效率低下，项目维护成本增加。

• BobbyTables2批评了现代库的粗粒度和不必要的功能集成。例如，一个简单的Web服务器可能附带了大量不相关的功能和协议支持，导致开发者为了避免复杂的依赖链而重新实现某些功能。

• bob1029强调了减少第三方依赖的重要性，以确保漏洞出现时能够快速响应。过多的依赖会增加系统脆弱性，任何一环的故障都会导致整个系统失效。

• ronbenton指出，即使是拥有大量资源的大型科技公司也会犯安全错误，因此在招聘时应更关注候选人对软件工程的理解，而不是解谜能力。

• dmos62以讽刺的方式表达了对软件行业混乱文化的无奈，认为诸如臃肿、封闭源代码和缺乏互操作性等问题是文化自我矛盾的体现。

• boznz提到，如果不使用现代框架或大规模云堆栈，可能会被认为是过时和脱节的，尽管这些技术可能带来不必要的复杂性。

• dang引用了2024年一篇关于精简软件的讨论文章，指出这个问题在行业内已经存在很长时间。

• gitroom认为，额外的代码堆积往往是因为开发者追求简单的安装或显得忙碌，而不是保持事情的简单性。

• al_borland指出，团队被期望快速交付，导致没有时间回溯和优化代码，从而产生技术债务。

• kristianp认为，软件臃肿的问题不在于依赖本身，而在于对依赖代码的质量控制。通过死代码消除等技术可以减少最终产品的臃肿。

• antfarm分享了自己学习Elixir和OTP以克服架构臃肿的经历，认为构建自定义解决方案可以避免引入过多的第三方组件。

• hilbert42总结了软件臃肿和安全问题的广泛影响，认为由于商业利益和技术生态的复杂性，这些问题在短期内难以解决。

补充讨论：
• jongjong描述了在工作中为了运行软件需要启动多个微服务，导致开发环境配置复杂且耗时，反映了现代开发环境中的操作复杂性。

争议焦点：
• 软件臃肿的定义和其对开发效率及安全的影响是讨论的核心。一部分人认为现代工具和框架带来的便利超过了其复杂性，而另一部分人则认为不必要的功能和依赖导致了维护困难和安全隐患。

43910745.article_content:
Computing
Magazine
Feature
April 2024
Why Bloat Is Still Software’s Biggest Vulnerability
A 2024 plea for lean software
Bert Hubert
08 Feb 2024
10 min read
Daniel Zender
This post is dedicated to the memory of
Niklaus Wirth
, a computing pioneer who passed away 1 January 2024. In 1995 he wrote an influential article called “
A Plea for Lean Software
,”
published in
Computer
, the magazine for members of the
IEEE Computer Society
, which I read early in my career as an entrepreneur and software developer. In what follows, I try to make the same case nearly 30 years later, updated for today’s computing horrors. A version of this post was
originally published
on my personal blog,
Berthub.eu
.
Some years ago I did a talk at a local university on
cybersecurity
, titled “
Cyber and Information Security: Have We All Gone Mad?
” It is still worth reading today since we
have
gone quite mad collectively.
The way we build and ship software these days is mostly ridiculous, leading to apps using millions of lines of code to open a garage door, and other simple programs importing
1,600 external code libraries
—dependencies—of unknown provenance.
Software security
is dire, which is a function both of the quality of the code and the sheer amount of it. Many of us
programmers
know the current situation is untenable. Many programmers (and their management) sadly haven’t ever experienced anything else. And for the rest of us, we rarely get the time to do a better job.
It is not just you; we are not merely suffering from nostalgia: Software really is very weird today.
Let me briefly go over the terrible state of software security, and then spend some time on why it is so bad. I also mention some regulatory and legislative things going on that we might use to make software quality a priority again. Finally, I talk about
an actual useful piece of software I wrote
as a proof of concept that one can still make
minimal and simple yet modern software
.
I hope that this post provides some mental and moral support for suffering programmers and technologists who want to improve things. It is not just you; We are not merely suffering from nostalgia: Software really is very weird today.
The terrible state of software security
Without going all
“Old man (48) yells at cloud
,” let me restate some obvious things. The state of software security is
dire
. If we only look at the past year, if you ran industry-standard software like
Ivanti
,
MOVEit
,
Outlook
,
Confluence
,
Barracuda Email Security Gateway
,
Citrix NetScaler ADC, and NetScaler Gateway
, chances are you got hacked. Even companies with near-infinite resources (like Apple and
Google
) made
trivial “worst practice” security mistakes
that put
their customers in danger
. Yet we continue to rely on all these products.
Software is now (rightfully) considered so dangerous that we tell everyone not to run it themselves.
Software is now (rightfully) considered so dangerous that we tell everyone not to run it themselves. Instead, you are supposed to leave that to an “
X
as a service” provider, or perhaps just to “the cloud.” Compare this to a hypothetical situation where cars are so likely to catch fire that the advice is not to drive a car yourself, but to leave that to professionals who are always accompanied by professional firefighters.
The assumption is then that the cloud is somehow able to make insecure software trustworthy. Yet in the past year, we’ve learned that Microsoft’s
email platform was thoroughly hacked
, including classified government email. (
Twice!
) There are also
well-founded worries about the security of the Azure cloud
. Meanwhile, industry darling Okta, which provides cloud-based software that enables user log-in to various applications,
got comprehensively owned
. This was their second breach within two years. Also, there was a suspicious spate of Okta users subsequently getting hacked.
Clearly, we need better software.
The
European Union
has launched three pieces of
legislation
to this effect:
NIS2 for important services
; the
Cyber Resilience Act
for almost all commercial software and electronic devices; and a revamped
Product Liability Directive
that also extends to software. Legislation is always hard, and it remains to be seen
if they got it right
. But that software security is terrible enough these days to warrant legislation seems obvious.
Why software security is so bad
I want to touch on incentives. The situation today is clearly working well for commercial operators. Making more secure software takes time and is a lot of work, and the current security incidents don’t appear to be impacting the bottom line or stock prices. You can
speed up time to market by cutting corners
. So from an economic standpoint, what we see is entirely predictable. Legislation could be very important in changing this equation.
The security of software depends on two factors—the
density
of security issues in the
source code
and the sheer
amount of code
accessible by
hackers
. A

data.title: Show HN: Whippy Term - GUI terminal for embedded development (Linux and Windows)
data.author: SurvivorTed
data.article_summary: WhippyTerm是一款现代终端程序，支持Windows和Linux系统，拥有现代用户界面和多种独特功能。它主要面向嵌入式开发者，支持串行通信（如RS232、RS485、RS422、TTL UART）和网络协议（TCP/IP、UDP），并通过插件支持I2C和SPI协议。该程序内置书签、十六进制 dumps功能，并可通过插件扩展。它还支持二进制和ASCII数据块的发送，适用于处理串行流和消息块协议如UDP，内置ANSI终端仿真，并可通过插件添加其他仿真如VT100。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：新发布的跨平台串行终端工具及其功能和局限

不同观点：
• alias_neo: 认为该工具看起来很不错，尤其是对于较少进行嵌入式开发的人来说，像ESPHome这样的工具已经减少了手动构建的需求。不过，作为Linux用户，连接minicom或screen时的语法记忆让他感到有些烦恼。尽管目前无法提供更多反馈，但这个工具激励他考虑新的嵌入式项目来尝试。

• AriedK: 对工具的send buffers和实时显示功能表示赞赏，但指出缺少像Tera Term中的“禁用 incoming 串流自动滚动”的选项，特别是类似于Tera Term的“仅在最底行自动滚动”功能。

• SurvivorTed: 作为该工具的开发者，SurvivorTed介绍了该工具的设计目标和功能，包括支持Linux和Windows系统，现代GUI界面（如标签页、可拉出面板等），以及支持二进制协议、ANSI转义序列、XModem协议、二进制块、十六进制转储、桥接两个连接等功能。他发布了工具的源链接并希望大家试用。

• mystified5016: 表示该工具可能取代自己定制的串行监控工具。他询问是否可以通过插件过滤端口列表，特别是在Windows系统上，串行通过蓝牙创建的两个虚拟端口问题，以及其定制工具如何过滤仅显示出站端口和获取蓝牙设备名称的功能。

• svth: 质疑为何该工具不支持macOS，表达了对macOS兼容性的关注。

补充讨论：
• 该工具的功能和设计目标主要集中在满足嵌入式开发者的需求，特别是在Linux和Windows平台上的使用。
• 用户对工具的功能有进一步的期望和建议，如AriedK对自动滚动功能的改进建议，mystified5016对蓝牙端口过滤功能的询问。
• macOS用户的兼容性问题被提出，显示出该工具在跨平台支持上的局限性。

Home
Whippy Term
Whippy Term is a modern terminal program.  It has been designed to have
a modern UI and to run on modern OS's like Windows and Linux.  It also
has a number of unique features such as bookmarks, built in hex dumps,
extending through plugins, and native support for binary protocols.
Embedded Developers
It is primarily aimed at embedded developers that need to talk to their
devices. It supports serial communication such as serial ports
(RS232, RS485, RS422, TTL UART), TCP/IP, UDP. It also supports
protocols such as I2C and SPI though plugins.
Terminal emulations
Terminal emulations such as ANSI and VT100 can be added (ANSI is builtin
and always available) through plugins.
Binary protocols
WhippyTerm also support working with binary protocols, in both
serial streams like RS232, and message block protocols like UDP.
Support for sending blocks of binary or AscII data is included to
better work with embedded devices and binary protocols.

• 该工具的功能和设计目标主要集中在满足嵌入式开发者的需求，特别是在Linux和Windows平台上的使用。

• macOS用户的兼容性问题被提出，显示出该工具在跨平台支持上的局限性。

data.article_summary: "Old Timey Mono" 是一种基于1906年 Reproducing Typewriter 字体设计的等宽字体，专为提升可读性和避免复制失真设计，适合编码和剧本写作。它包括常规版和代码专用版，后者具有更易辨识的字符设计。该字体支持广泛的语言和字符集，包括拉丁字母、西里尔字母和希腊字母，并涵盖多种 Unicode 区块。字体适用于多种操作系统，并为不同环境提供了字体平滑建议。该项目文件包含源代码、二进制文件和相关资源，用户可以从发布页面下载。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：一款名为 Old Timey Mono 的字体的特点、使用场景及改进建议

不同观点：
• **[dsevil]** 介绍 Old Timey Mono 及其变体 Old Timey Code，指出该字体源自1906年的字体 Reproducing Typewriter，并经过改进以提高小字号下的可读性，特别适用于编码场景。该用户提供了字体的下载链接，并邀请其他人提出意见。

SPECIMEN
https://webonastick.com/fonts/old-timey-mono/
About
A clean monospace typeface based on Reproducing Typewriter which was
available as early as 1906.  Reproducing Typewriter was designed for
simulating typewritten letters in smaller point sizes for
advertisements, catalogs, etc., where readability and/or distortion
resulting from duplication were issues with faces based on actual
typewriters at the time.
"Sight Saver" typewriter faces designed for readability were also
available, though they were at larger sizes than ordinary pica or
elite typefaces.
I developed Old Timey Mono because I thought those characteristics
would make it a good basis for a coding font with an antique
aesthetic.  You may have seen Reproducing Typewriter used in the
Turbo Pascal 3.0
product manual.
At a size of 12pt (6 lines per inch), Old Timey Mono is a pica font,
or 10 characters per inch, like Courier.  It
should
be suitable
for screenplay writing.
Code Variant
Along with Old Timey Mono, there is Old Timey Code.  It has a slashed
zero, disambiguated digit one, selected punctuation marks made larger,
and a few certain small letters modified.
Mintty Users
Text -> Font Smoothing -> Partial.  I wish I didn't have to tell you
to do this.
Character Set Coverage
Extensive coverage of Latin, Cyrillic, and Greek scripts.  Language
support is detailed below.
Includes the following sets of characters in their entirety (excepting
controls):
ASCII
ISO-8859-1
Code Page 437
Code Page 850
Windows Glyph List 4 (WGL4)
Adobe Glyph List for New Fonts (AGLFN)
Windows 1252's additional characters
Mac OS Roman, except for the ff and fi ligatures (which don't belong in monospace fonts)
The following Unicode blocks in their entirety:
U+2500–U+257F Box Drawing
U+2580–U+259F Block Elements
U+2800–U+28FF Braille Patterns
U+0100–U+017F Latin Extended-A
And then some.
And a few extras!
Languages Supported
At least according to
https://googlefonts.github.io/shaperglot/
.  As
in, I dragged the font there and copied the list of languages it had
yellow or green indicating full coverage.

data.author: quelsolaar

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：C语言中使用union进行类型转换的合法性及有效类型（effective type）的概念

不同观点：
• **[pansa2的观点]**：pansa2认为，当union包含内存的有效类型时，通过union访问内存是合法的。他提供了一个例子，其中`union`包含`int`和`float`类型，并指出即便从未使用`union`中的`f`成员，只要`union`包含`int`类型，通过`i`成员访问是合法的。他还提到有人建议避免使用union进行类型转换，而应使用`memcpy`，并询问union方法在C中是否有问题，或者是否在C++中被认为是未定义行为。

• **[cancerhacker的观点]**：cancerhacker从更底层的角度看待问题，认为C语言编写代码时应考虑到其如何编译为汇编语言。他强调了理解代码如何在底层执行的重要性，并建议开发者使用工具（如godbolt.org或编译器的`-save-temps`标志）来观察生成的汇编代码。他批评了现代开发者缺乏对底层机制的理解，甚至开玩笑地表示对新一代开发者不熟悉命令行编译感到不满。

• **[jklowden的观点]**：jklowden对有效类型的概念表示强烈不满，特别是当涉及到静态分配、堆栈分配和堆分配的变量时。他认为，无论数据是在堆上通过`malloc`分配的还是在其他地方分配的，都应该有明确的类型定义。他批评了标准委员会在类型系统上的决策，认为这些决策没有为开发者提供实际的帮助。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点在于C语言中使用union进行类型转换的合法性及有效类型的定义。pansa2关注union的实际使用效果及与C++的不同，而jklowden则对有效类型的概念本身提出质疑，认为其不利于实际开发。

• 另一个值得注意的讨论点是cancerhacker对底层汇编语言的理解及其对现代开发者技能的看法，这虽然不是直接的技术争议，但体现了对C语言底层执行机制的重视。

• 最后，pansa2提到的`memcpy`方法与union方法的对比，以及在C和C++中的不同行为，也是讨论的一个重要方面。

data.title: Alignment is not free: How model upgrades can silence your confidence signals
data.author: karinemellata
data.article_summary: 这篇文章标题为《Monitor. Respond. Prevail. with Variance》，主要介绍了一款由Variance公司推出的工具。该工具旨在帮助企业实时监控业务数据，迅速做出响应，并最终在竞争中取得优势。文章强调了Variance工具的三个核心功能：监控（Monitor）、响应（Respond）和制胜（Prevail）。通过使用该工具，企业可以更有效地管理其运营和市场策略，提升整体竞争力。文章还提供了"开始使用"（Get Started）的指引，鼓励用户尝试该解决方案。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：OpenAI模型对齐（alignment）与模型性能、创造力之间的关系，以及对LLM在实际应用中的可靠性和限制的讨论。

不同观点：
• **Centigonal**：对文章中提到的对齐改进导致“信心信号”丢失表示困惑。他质疑作者如何确定对齐就是导致该问题的原因，因为以前的模型也经过了对齐调整，且模型蒸馏可能破坏了熵信号。

• **behnamoh**：支持对齐可能降低模型创造力的观点，并引用了一篇论文（https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.05587），将这种现象比作人类在受到言论限制时变得更加保守，无法自由表达所有想法。

• **qwertytyyuu**：对人们将大型语言模型（LLM）用于高精度系统表示担忧，暗示LLM的可靠性可能存在问题。

• **user_7832**：讽刺地指出，文章本身的部分内容读起来像是由LLM生成的，质疑文章的撰写质量和内容真实性。

• **erwin-co**：建议创建一个完全原始、未经审查的LLM，认为这样可能会使模型更“智能”。

• **sega_sai**：提议让模型在输出结果时附带一个概率值，以反映该陈述的准确性，从而提高模型的透明度和可信度。

• **rusk**：简单提及升级脚本的必要性，认为这是一种常规操作（“plus ca change”）。

• **gotoeleven**：认为关于LLM因政治正确性而变笨的研究发现已经变得像闹剧，并建议将对齐/去偏作为次级过滤器，独立于核心模型。他还指出，获取足够的数据训练这个过滤器可能很困难，最好将用户身份纳入目标。

补充讨论：
• **争议焦点**：LLM的对齐过程是否会损害模型的创造力和性能。部分评论者认为对齐限制了模型的自由度，从而降低了其智能表现和创造力。
• **技术提议**：有评论者建议通过技术手段（如概率输出、独立过滤器）提升模型的可靠性和透明度，以解决对齐带来的问题。
• **用户担忧**：有用户对LLM在高精度系统中的应用表示担忧，反映了对模型可靠性和准确性的关注。

总体来看，讨论围绕LLM的对齐、创造力、可靠性和技术改进展开，涉及理论探讨和技术建议。

data.title: VVVVVV Source Code
data.author: radeeyate
data.article_summary: 这篇文章介绍了独立游戏《VVVVVV》的源代码仓库。游戏由Terry Cavanagh创作，音乐由Magnus Pålsson制作。源代码包括桌面和移动版本，存放于指定文件夹中。玩家可以自行编译游戏供个人使用，但若要分发需查看LICENSE.md文件。游戏更新讨论主要在非官方的VVVVVV Discord服务器中的vvvvvv-code频道进行。文章还列出了游戏的贡献者名单和各种技术信息，如代码语言比例和最新版本发布情况。游戏可在thelettervsixtim.es购买以支持开发者。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕游戏VVVVVV及其开源的讨论，包括游戏开发、代码质量、游戏体验和开源影响等方面。

不同观点：
• 一些人赞赏Terry Cavanagh的开放源代码决定，认为这是对游戏社区的积极贡献。例如，[gallerdude]分享了与Terry共进午餐并获得人生建议的经历，强调了Terry的友善和开放态度。
• [senand]则对游戏代码质量提出批评，引用Terry自己对代码中不良编程习惯的承认，认为游戏代码往往质量不高，存在许多临时解决方案。
• [damnitbuilds]和[rafram]同样对代码质量表示惊讶，但对Terry能在如此代码基础上创造出优秀游戏表示钦佩。

补充讨论：
• 游戏体验：[peterldowns]和[jmmv]等玩家分享了自己玩VVVVVV和Super Hexagon的积极体验，尽管对某些关卡难度（如veni vidi vici）感到挫败。[babuskov]强调了游戏的简洁性和音乐的优秀。
• 技术实现：[hbn]解释了游戏中一些设计决策的原因，如使用表情符号代替文字以避免语言和语法问题。[kristoff_it]提到游戏在不同平台上的可用性，通过Zig包管理器实现。[oneeyedpigeon]则对游戏的域名表示赞赏。
• 开源讨论：[dang]提供了与其他相关讨论的链接，提出了开源是否值得的问题，并引用了其他关于游戏代码质量的讨论。
• 其他推荐：[lazycouchpotato]向喜欢VVVVVV的玩家推荐了另一款游戏LOVE，扩展了讨论的范围。

争议焦点：
• 游戏代码质量与游戏成功之间的关系。尽管代码存在问题，但游戏本身获得了积极评价，这引发了对代码质量是否影响游戏成功的讨论。

data.title: EPA Plans to Shut Down the Energy Star Program
data.author: danso
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Energy Star计划的成效、问题及相关争议

不同观点：
• **支持Energy Star计划**：
   - [timoth3y] 认为Energy Star在过去30年中非常成功，得到了行业的广泛支持，减少了消费者的总拥有成本（TCO），并每年节省了数千亿千瓦时的电力。该计划对于美国电网的现代化至关重要。
   - [adzm] 强调Energy Star让他能够清楚地了解产品的能耗，这增加了对产品能耗准确性的信任。
   - [hristov] 认为Energy Star帮助消费者避免购买到能耗高的产品，并迫使制造商提高能效，对消费者有利。
   - [standardUser] 指出能效技术对减少排放和节省电费非常有效，Energy Star推动了这一进程。

• **质疑和批评Energy Star计划**：
   - [withinrafael] 引用了2010年GAO的报告，指出Energy Star存在欺诈和滥用的可能，如将虚假的燃气闹钟标记为符合Energy Star标准。
   - [spamizbad] 认为政府推出的改善措施往往增加了消费者的开支，并对Energy Star的实际效果持怀疑态度。
   - [insane_dreamer] 提到有些制造商可能会隐瞒和撒谎，但对整体上Energy Star对行业的推动作用持肯定态度，同时批评了削弱EPA监管的做法。

• **比较与国际视角**：
   - [pfoof] 作为欧洲人，认为欧盟的A到G能效等级比Energy Star和EnergyGuide更易读和实用。
   - [standardUser] 认为美国在能效方面比欧洲和东亚落后至少十年。

• **其他观点**：
   - [sokoloff] 澄清了Energy Guide和Energy Star的区别，分别由FTC和EPA管理。
   - [bcoates] 提问是否有人真的根据Energy Star标签做出购买决策，而不是基于能效和总拥有成本的一般考虑。
   - [GiorgioG] 表示从未关注过Energy Star标签。

补充讨论：
• **争议焦点**：Energy Star计划的实际效果和必要性是讨论的核心。支持者强调其在能效提升和消费者成本节约方面的贡献，而批评者则关注其潜在的欺诈问题和国际比较中的不足。
• **政治因素**：有评论提到政府政策变化对Energy Star计划的影响，以及不同政治立场对环保政策的影响（如[insane_dreamer] 提到特朗普可能的举措）。

通过以上不同观点，可以看出Energy Star计划既有显著的成效，也存在一定的争议和改进空间。

   - [standardUser] 指出能效技术对减少排放和节省电费非常有效，Energy Star推动了这一进程。

• **质疑和批评Energy Star计划**：
   - [withinrafael] 引用了2010年GAO的报告，指出Energy Star存在欺诈和滥用的可能，如将虚假的燃气闹钟标记为符合Energy Star标准。
   - [spamizbad] 认为政府推出的改善措施往往增加了消费者的开支，并对Energy Star的实际效果持怀疑态度。
   - [insane_dreamer] 提到有些制造商可能会隐瞒和撒谎，但对整体上Energy Star对行业的推动作用持肯定态度，同时批评了削弱EPA监管的做法。

• **比较与国际视角**：
   - [pfoof] 作为欧洲人，认为欧盟的A到G能效等级比Energy Star和EnergyGuide更易读和实用。
   - [standardUser] 认为美国在能效方面比欧洲和东亚落后至少十年。

• **其他观点**：
   - [sokoloff] 澄清了Energy Guide和Energy Star的区别，分别由FTC和EPA管理。
   - [bcoates] 提问是否有人真的根据Energy Star标签做出购买决策，而不是基于能效和总拥有成本的一般考虑。
   - [GiorgioG] 表示从未关注过Energy Star标签。

补充讨论：
• **争议焦点**：Energy Star计划的实际效果和必要性是讨论的核心。支持者强调其在能效提升和消费者成本节约方面的贡献，而批评者则关注其潜在的欺诈问题和国际比较中的不足。
• **政治因素**：有评论提到政府政策变化对Energy Star计划的影响，以及不同政治立场对环保政策的影响（如[insane_dreamer] 提到特朗普可能的举措）。

通过以上不同观点，可以看出Energy Star计划既有显著的成效，也存在一定的争议和改进空间。

data.title: Scientists have found a way to 'tattoo' tardigrades
data.author: PaulHoule
data.article_summary: 科学家利用缓步动物（俗称水熊虫）几乎不可摧毁的特性，开发了一种微纹身技术，通过冰刻法在其表面绘制微型图案。研究人员将缓步动物置于隐生状态，用电子束在覆盖其表面的冻结有机化合物上刻画图案。解冻后，这些缓步动物恢复了活力，身上留下了微小的“纹身”，且行为没有发生变化。该技术可用于在活体组织上打印微型电子设备或传感器，未来有望推动微生物仿生和生物医学应用的发展。这项研究发表在《Nano Letters》期刊上。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于在缓步动物（tardigrades）身上进行微电子打印技术的潜在应用和伦理问题

不同观点：
• [技术应用的积极展望]  
一些评论对该技术在微电子、传感器打印以及未来可能的生物医学应用（如微生物生化人）感到兴奋和期待。例如，[seeknotfind]认为该技术可以用于在活体组织上打印电子设备，[b3lvedere]则提到虽然对微生物生化人的存在感到复杂，但认可其潜在的科技进步。

• [娱乐性和科幻联想]  
部分评论以幽默或科幻的角度看待这一技术，认为其可以激发有趣的科幻情节或替代宇宙设想。例如，[musicale]开玩笑说未来的缓步动物可能会要求去除纹身，[davidw]希望看到相关的漫画，[jancsika]则畅想了一个以缓步动物为宇航员的科幻世界。

• [伦理和动物福利的争议]  
一些评论对该技术是否人道提出了质疑。例如，[butlike]指出虽然40%的缓步动物在实验中存活，但“存活”不等于“繁荣”，并质疑这是否是人类应采取的最佳做法，[kaonwarb]虽然对实验结果印象深刻，但也承认需要更多研究。

• [实际应用的质疑]  
有评论对该技术的实际应用效果表示怀疑。例如，[alach11]认为虽然可以用标记的缓步动物进行监控，但这种方式效率不高，更像是一种间谍电影的情节，而非现实应用。

补充讨论：
• [创意和商业化联想]  
一些评论提到这种技术可能带来的商业化或创意用途。例如，[neilv]认为在当前人类面临生存威胁的背景下，缓步动物可能成为奢侈品市场的对象，[zombot]则开玩笑说公司可能很快会在缓步动物背上印制商标。

• [对创意来源的好奇]  
[cloudking]对这种创意是如何产生的表示好奇，而[chankstein38]则以幽默的方式提到这种技术可以帮助区分不同的缓步动物。

总体而言，评论围绕技术的潜在应用、科幻娱乐、伦理问题以及实际可行性展开了多角度的讨论。

Scientists have found a way to 'tattoo' tardigrades
by
American Chemical Society
This tardigrade is sporting a new "tattoo"—represented in this magnified image by the highlighted dots. Credit:
Nano Letters
(2025). DOI: 10.1021/acs.nanolett.5c00378
If you haven't heard of a tardigrade before, prepare to be wowed. These clumsy, eight-legged creatures, nicknamed water bears, are about half a millimeter long and can survive practically anything: freezing temperatures, near starvation, high pressure, radiation exposure, outer space and more. Researchers reporting in the journal
Nano Letters
took advantage of the tardigrade's nearly indestructible nature and gave the critters tiny "tattoos" to test a microfabrication technique to build microscopic, biocompatible devices.
"Through this technology, we're not just creating micro-tattoos on tardigrades—we're extending this capability to various living organisms, including bacteria," explains Ding Zhao, a co-author of the
paper
.
Microfabrication has revolutionized electronics and photonics, creating micro- and nanoscale devices ranging from microprocessors and solar cells to biosensors that detect food contamination or cancerous cells. But the technology could also advance medicine and
biomedical engineering
, if researchers can adapt
microfabrication techniques
to make them compatible with the biological realm.
So, Zhao, Min Qiu and colleagues employed a process that carves a pattern with an electron beam into a thin layer of ice coating living tissue, called ice lithography, leaving behind a design when the remaining ice sublimates. And what creature is better suited to being frozen, coated in ice, and then exposed to an electron beam than the nearly indestructible
tardigrade
?
The team put tardigrades into a cryptobiotic state (a sort of half-dead, suspended animation) by slowly dehydrating the microscopic animals. Then, the researchers placed an individual tardigrade onto a carbon-composite paper, cooled the sheet below -226°F (-143°C), and covered the water bear with a protective layer of anisole—an organic compound that smells like anise. The frozen anisole protected the tardigrade's surface from the focused
electron beam
as it drew the pattern.
When exposed to the beam, the anisole reacted and formed a new biocompatible chemical compound that stuck to the tardigrade's surface at higher temperatures. As the tardigrade warmed to room temperature under vacuum, any unreacted frozen anisole sublimated and left behind the pattern of reacted anisole. Finally, the researchers rehydrated and revived the tardigrade, which then sported a new tattoo.
The precision of this technique allowed the team to create a variety of micropatterns: squares, dots, and lines as small as 72 nanometers wide, and even the university's logo. About 40% of the tardigrades survived the procedure, and the researchers say that could be improved with further fine tuning. Most importantly, the tardigrades didn't seem to mind their new tattoos: Once rehydrated, they showed no changes in behavior. These results indicate that this technique could be suitable for printing micro-electronics or sensors onto living tissue.
Gavin King, a researcher credited with inventing the ice lithography technique who was not involved in this study, concludes, "It is challenging to pattern living matter, and this advance portends a new generation of biomaterial devices and biophysical sensors that were previously only present in science fiction."
After this first step, Zhao and Qiu hope that this work could enable advancements such as microbial cyborgs and other biomedical applications in the future.
More information:
Zhirong Yang et al, Patterning on Living Tardigrades,
Nano Letters
(2025).

data.title: Jury orders NSO to pay $167M for hacking WhatsApp users
data.author: Bender
data.article_summary: WhatsApp has won a major legal victory against Israeli firm NSO Group, receiving $167 million in punitive damages and $444 million in compensatory damages. NSO was found liable for exploiting a WhatsApp vulnerability to install its Pegasus spyware on roughly 1,400 devices, targeting journalists, activists, and government officials. The "clickless" exploit allowed NSO to hack phones via a simple call. Despite NSO's defense that it only sells to governments for law enforcement, the court ruled against the company. This case marks a significant win for privacy advocates and sets a potential legal precedent against spyware companies. NSO's practices were further exposed through the litigation process.

不同观点：
• IG_Semmelweiss认为，NSO Group被美国政府列入实体清单，已经无法参与美国银行网络，因此WhatsApp的判决对NSO在美国境内的资产没有实际影响。该评论提到了NSO在2017年有约500名员工，并引用了维基百科的资料作为论据。

• jimnotgym指出，出售应用程序漏洞的人应该面临刑事制裁，并质疑为何自己如果做同样的事会入狱，而NSO却没有受到类似惩罚。

• 另一个值得注意的点是对不同主体应承担的责任和法律制裁的讨论，包括开发者、出售者和使用者。

A jury has awarded WhatsApp $167 million in punitive damages in a case the company brought against Israel-based NSO Group for exploiting a software vulnerability that hijacked the phones of thousands of users.
The verdict, reached Tuesday, comes as a major victory not just for Meta-owned WhatsApp but also for privacy- and security-rights advocates who have long criticized the practices of NSO and other exploit sellers. The jury also awarded WhatsApp $444 million in compensatory damages.
Clickless exploit
WhatsApp sued NSO
in 2019
for an attack that targeted roughly 1,400 mobile phones belonging to attorneys, journalists, human-rights activists, political dissidents, diplomats, and senior foreign government officials. NSO, which works on behalf of governments and law enforcement authorities in various countries, exploited a critical WhatsApp vulnerability that allowed it to install NSO’s proprietary spyware
Pegasus
on iOS and Android devices. The clickless exploit worked by placing a call to a target's app. A target did not have to answer the call to be infected.
“Today’s verdict in WhatsApp’s case is an important step forward for privacy and security as the first victory against the development and use of illegal spyware that threatens the safety and privacy of everyone,” WhatsApp said in a
statement
. “Today, the jury’s decision to force NSO, a notorious foreign spyware merchant, to pay damages is a critical deterrent to this malicious industry against their illegal acts aimed at American companies and the privacy and security of the people we serve.”
NSO created WhatsApp accounts in 2018 and used them a year later to initiate calls that exploited the critical vulnerability on phones, which, among others, included 100 members of "civil society" from 20 countries, according to an investigation research group Citizen Lab performed on behalf of WhatsApp. The calls passed through WhatsApp servers and injected malicious code into the memory of targeted devices. The targeted phones would then use WhatsApp servers to connect to malicious servers maintained by NSO.
After discovering the attack, WhatsApp shut them down with a software update that patched the critical vulnerability and notified target users that their devices had been hacked. In the weeks following, Facebook and WhatsApp also kicked NSO employees off their platforms.
WhatsApp’s lawsuit was unprecedented at the time because it was among the first to take aim at the unregulated industry selling sophisticated malware services to governments around the world. NSO argued that it should be immune from such legal actions because it sold tools solely to licensed government intelligence and law-enforcement agencies for use in fighting terrorism, child sex abuse, and other serious crimes. The company said it barred customers from using the tools against human-rights activists, journalists, and dissidents. NSO also said it acted as a check against strongly encrypted platforms that could be used as a haven for criminals.
Tuesday’s verdict—from a jury empaneled by the US District Court for the Northern District of California—is a sharp rebuke of NSO’s defense.
“Turns out regular people don't like companies that help dictators hack dissidents,” John Scott-Railton, a senior researcher at Citizen Lab,
wrote
on Bluesky. “NSO had all the fancy legal arguments. And all the PR spin. But when their conduct got laid bare... the jury sent a massive Monsanto-style punitive damages signal. Other spyware companies: you may be next.”
Besides setting a possible precedent for hacking victims and their technology providers, WhatsApp’s suit exposed NSO practices the company had long tried to keep secret. Last year, the judge hearing the case
ordered
NSO to reveal some of the source code that makes its products work. The litigation also exposed who some of NSO’s customers were and the location of many of the targeted WhatsApp users.
NSO Group didn’t immediately respond to a request for comment.

data.author: bookofjoe
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于迷走神经刺激（VNS）治疗及其在创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）等病症中的应用和有效性的讨论。

不同观点：
• **taurath的观点**：认为迷走神经理论尚未被完全证明，并且在PTSD治疗中的效果存疑，因为目前对其内在机制缺乏了解。taurath指出，PTSD的治疗往往只关注症状而非根本原因，且现有的“基于证据”的治疗方法存在不足，许多患者未被有效覆盖。同时，taurath对VNS植入设备表示关注，认为尽管其对多种病症有效，但原因不明。

• **aucisson_masque的观点**：对VNS设备持怀疑态度，质疑为何简单的颈部按摩不能达到同样效果，尤其如果患者能够自行操作按摩的话。这暗示了对设备复杂性和必要性的疑问。

• **jama211的观点**：对讨论主题表示简单的兴趣，没有深入展开。

• **BugsJustFindMe的观点**：以幽默方式质疑VNS设备是否需要在患者有顽固性打嗝的情况下才使用，暗示对设备适用范围的困惑或不理解。

补充讨论：
• VNS设备的有效性与其机制不明之间的矛盾：taurath和aucisson_masque都提到了对VNS设备的理解不足，尤其是为何它有效以及是否可以通过更简单的方式达到同样效果。

• 争议焦点：VNS设备是否过度复杂，尤其是与传统按摩等简单方式相比。同时，关于PTSD等病症的治疗方法有效性和科学依据的争议也被提及。

补充讨论：
• [999900000999] 认为当前产品只是多个现有技术的组合，建议聚焦于3-4种语言，并增加顾问和基础游戏化/测验功能。

data.title: docker2exe: Convert a Docker image to an executable
data.author: alexmolas
data.article_summary:
`docker2exe` 是一个可以将 Docker 镜像转换为可执行文件的工具。用户可以生成包含 Docker 镜像的可执行文件，并发送给其他人使用。主要功能包括：

1. **安装**：从发布页面下载二进制文件，并确保设备上安装了 Docker、GoLang 和 gzip。
2. **使用方法**：通过命令行创建可执行文件，例如 `docker2exe --name alpine --image alpine:3.9`，将生成不同系统下的可执行文件。
3. **执行**：运行生成的可执行文件时，工具会检查系统中是否存在指定镜像，若不存在则自动拉取。
4. **嵌入模式**：可将镜像打包进可执行文件中，运行时自动加载镜像。

该工具适用于小型镜像，生成的可执行文件体积较小（如小于10MB）。项目主要使用 Go 语言编写。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Docker与可执行文件的结合及其应用场景

不同观点：
• Epskampie认为Docker是必需的执行环境，强调了对Docker的依赖。
• dennydai建议使用shebang命令来简化Docker命令的执行。
• rullopat讽刺地指出这种方式会生成大体积的“Hello World”可执行文件，暗示文件过大不适合实际使用。
• nine_k幽默地对比了Docker与AppImage，认为AppImage是更现代的解决方案。
• rietta回忆了Visual Basic运行时和自解压WinZip文件，认为当前的Docker方案也是一种“臃肿”。
• kkapelon认为这只是一个Docker可执行文件的简单包装，仍然需要安装Docker。
• cik指出这类似于docker export和makeself的结合，并提到他们已经使用这种方式向特定客户交付预构建容器。
• fifilura质疑Docker的通用性，并提出是否有可能实现跨平台的原生可执行应用。
• hda111建议将podman和镜像嵌入一个可执行文件中，以实现无需Docker的自包含文件。
• ransom1538以讽刺的语气表示这是一种回归。
• arjav0703认为这对与不懂Docker的用户分享容器非常有用，特别是定制软件的场景。
• isaacimagine提到一个名为dockerc的工具，提供了一个相关资源的链接。
• Alex_001对这种方法表示赞赏，认为可以简化非技术用户的工具分享和CLI打包，但对启动时间和文件系统大小有所担忧。
• sunrunner对此表示失望，认为这是将部署工作“右移”，增加了用户负担，并质疑这种方式对文件系统资源的访问和沙箱化。
• aussieguy1234指出在Linux上性能损失较小，但在其他平台上可能因为需要使用Linux VM而导致性能问题。

补充讨论：
• Docker作为后端工具的适用性和其在跨平台可执行文件中的局限性。
• 对大体积可执行文件的实用性质疑。
• 不同工具和方法（如AppImage、podman）的比较和优劣讨论。
• 对技术用户与非技术用户需求的不同考虑。
• 对文件系统资源访问和沙箱化的技术讨论。
• 在Linux与其他平台上的性能差异分析。

docker2exe
This tool can be used to convert a Docker image to an executable that you can send to your friends!
Installation
Download a binary from the
releases page
.
$ mv docker2exe-darwin-amd64 docker2exe
$ chmod +x docker2exe
$ ./docker2exe --help
Requirements on the building device
Docker, GoLang and gzip are also required. Use your package manager to install them.
Requirements on the executing device
Docker is required.
Usage
To create a new binary:
$ docker2exe --name alpine --image alpine:3.9
This will create the following files:
dist
├── alpine-darwin-amd64
├── alpine-linux-amd64
├── alpine-windows-amd64
Now, you can run the executable:
$ dist/alpine-darwin-amd64 cat /etc/alpine-release
3.9.5
When the executable is run, we'll check for the
alpine:3.9.5
image on the user's system. If it doesn't exist, the executable will automatically run:
$ docker pull alpine:3.9.5
Embedded Mode
In this mode, if the specified image doesn't exist, we'll attempt to load it from a tarball that is embeddded in the executable.
$ docker2exe --name alpine --image alpine:3.9 --embed
When creating the executable above, the image was dumped to a tarball and baked into the resulting executable:
$ docker save alpine:3.9 | gzip > alpine.tar.gz
When the executable runs, we'll check for the
alpine:3.9
image on the user's system. If it doesn't exist, the executable will automatically run:
$ docker load alpine.tar.gz
For small images, this approach works great. In the example above, the resulting executable was under 10MB.

该工具适用于小型镜像，生成的可执行文件体积较小（如小于10MB）。项目主要使用 Go 语言编写。

data.title: (ab?)using Node module hooks to speed up development
data.author: sbjs
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了一种利用Node模块钩子加速前端开发的方法。作者希望使用JSX而不依赖React，并且希望拥有灵活的开发方式。为此，作者开发了一系列模块钩子，包括：一个将JSX转换为JS的模块加载器，允许直接导入和运行JSX文件；一个任意重映射 imports 的钩子，可以将 "react/jsx-runtime" 重映射到自定义实现；另一个钩子支持在找不到 ".js" 文件时自动寻找 ".ts", ".tsx", ".jsx" 文件，方便代码共享；还有一个基于 FileTree 的钩子，利用查询字符串缓存破坏机制加载最新文件版本，并通过监听文件变化自动更新前端。此外，通过模块版本控制，确保仅在模块或其依赖项变化时重新执行，同时保持运行时状态，并提供模块失效事件以正确处理单例销毁。

#
(ab?)using Node module hooks to speed up development
I wanted a much faster way to develop the front-end of my site.
And I wanted to use JSX as the templating language but without React.
And I didn't want to be tied down to any one way of doing anything.
So I made a bunch of orthogonal stuff. Half evolved into
module hooks
.
One module loader transforms JSX to JS with the function you give it.
Now I can import and run JSX files natively in JSX.
Another remaps imports arbitrarily.
Now I can remap
react/jsx-runtime
to
./my-jsx-impl.js
for experimentation.
Another looks for
.{ts,tsx,jsx}
when
.js
isn't found.
Now I can import
foo.tsx
as
foo.js
which helps with client code sharing.
The final one works with
FileTree
.
It resolves to the latest version of a file using query string cache busting.
And it loads the latest one from the FileTree for speed and fewer disk reads.
This works because FileTree can (optionally) keep itself updated on disk changes.
I added
filesUpdated
events to the FileTree's EventEmitter.
Now I can rebuild my whole front-end whenever any file changes.
But I made sure to use module versioning to not discard unchanged state.
Modules are only invalidated and re-executed if they
or their deps
change.
This also allows me to keep persisted runtime state between site rebuilds.
I also added
moduleInvalidated
events and the
onModuleInvalidated
method.
This way, a module can run a callback when its being replaced by a newer version.
Now I can
properly dispose singletons
instead of restarting the whole process.

data.title: MCP Is Not Good, Yet
data.author: coloneltcb
data.article_summary: 本文讨论了Model Context Protocol（MCP）服务器在当前阶段的局限性。尽管许多人称赞MCP的潜力，并认为它应被广泛采用和整合到各种用户界面和代理工具中，但实际上MCP仍未成熟。最初的MCP通过stdio和本地服务器运行，需要用户手动配置访问令牌，体验不佳，未获得广泛实际应用。尽管MCP后来增加了更好的流接口和原生OAuth支持，理论上增强了实用性，但其实施中仍存在诸多问题。例如，OAuth功能不完善，连接时常失败，配置复杂且多样，工具调用错误频繁。即使成功配置，用户也可能面临无限权限提示和工具调用错误。尽管MCP的概念具有吸引力，但目前它仍处于早期开发阶段，远未达到成熟，不适合大规模使用。

• 尽管承认MCP试图解决的问题（工具难以构建和分享）是实际存在的，但Patleeman觉得MCP尚未达到能够提供良好开发体验的阶段。

补充讨论：
• Patleeman提到服务器也可以是本地运行的进程，客户端可以启动服务器，但需要提供NPX或UVX命令。这表明工具链和命令的使用可能增加了理解和操作的复杂性。
• 讨论中涉及了对MCP未来改进的期望，暗示当前版本可能仍在开发和优化中。

争议焦点：MCP的当前成熟度和易用性是主要争议点，特别是对于新手开发者来说，理解和使用上存在一定的门槛。

43910399.article_content:
Something’s been bothering me lately surrounding the conversation of MCP servers. Everyone, seemingly, is talking about how MCPs are great, and we should be building MCPs, and adopting MCPs, and rethinking UIs with MCPs, becoming best friends with MCPs, getting married to MCPs, you know, the works.
Except they’re not good. Not yet.
If you’ve somehow been living in a cave and don’t know what the acronym of the month stands for, MCP is short for
Model Context Protocol
. Its a specification started over at Anthropic, designed to create a pluggable architecture for a bunch of concerns we see in things like Agents. One of its most simple value props: it lets you plug in
tools
to any agent (e.g. Cursor, Claude, etc), as long as they support the protocol. Hypothetically super powerful.
It started as a local server that operated primarily through stdio (standard input, as in piping to a unix socket). A bunch of rapid fire prototypes were built, mostly requiring you to wire up an access token from various cloud services, and boom, MCP was born. That experience kind of sucks though. The world does not operate on asking users to go create access tokens, plug them into config files, and debug various running processes on your machine. It didn’t gain a ton of real world traction.
Fast forward a few weeks and MCP announced it would support two extremely important shifts:
A better streaming interface, making it easier for developers to incorporate the architecture in existing web environments.
Native OAuth support. This is arguably the most important iteration.
I have a belief system that software design largely doesn’t change, so when I saw they were going to support a native, wide-spread authentication flow, I knew there was potential. That combined with a better web spec, and some peers (e.g. Cloudflare) jumping on the
super early bird
bandwagon, led to shipping
Sentry’s MCP
. While I’m sure we were not the first, we’re certainly one of the first to support a real world production MCP server from an existing (ugh)
enterprise
business. We did that because the future of the architecture is compelling, and being able to plug something like Sentry into Cursor makes a lot of sense.
It made so much sense in fact that I decided I’d wing it and put on my YouTuber hat one evening:
If you’ve been following me on Twitter, or you’ve seen any of the videos I’ve published, you’ll note that there’s a huge swath of problems with the current implementation. I promise you, what you’ve seen from me publicly, I’ve barely touched on those problems.
First, OAuth barely functions today. Its not even yet supported by most consumers (e.g. Cursor), so we hack around it by using
mcp-remote
. Its a great proof of concept, but regularly the authentication breaks and you’re left wiping a random folder from your disk to force it to fix itself.
Lets say you actually get auth working. Great! Except its still not connecting, and none of the consumers give you a shred of detail on why. Some of them handle this better than others, but generally speaking, all of them break in a variety of ways.
It’s at best, beta software.
One common example of breakage is it will simply fail to connect. It believes (correctly
or not
) authentication is valid, but is still unable to connect to the service.
Or maybe if you’re really unlucky, it needs
npx
access (because you’re using
mcp-remote
) and it can’t figure out how to even launch that process. Even though you’re working on a Node application. Even though Cursor is half written in JavaScript. You probably just configured the JSON wrong tbqh. After all, there’s only
one
,
two
,
three
, an ever expanding number of ways you can configure MCP across clients.
Maybe you actually get it fully working and you can write a prompt that queries it, now you’re in for a fun surprise of infinite permission prompts combined with fairly regular incorrect tool calls. Don’t worry, the people working on the MCPs can fix that by giving more context in their tool definitions.
Oh wait, you’re using VS Code?
If
you were randomly debugging MCP in an earlier step, you might have the logs open and notice
gpt-4o
seems to have a 1024 character limit on tool descriptions and then just truncates it? We didn’t want any context anyways. Maybe we just create more dedicated tools to work around it. You know, instead of a
search_sentry
tool, we expose a
search_errors
,
search_traces
,
search_logs
and we simplify its ability to mess things up. Wow that actually works! Wait I have too many tools? Oh no its calling the wrong tool even more often now!
It must be good though, because companies you didn’t even realize still exist are even buying advertisements for it!
Hopefully you get the point.
Despite what many people on the internet would have you believe, MCP is not ready for mass consumption. Its a beautiful idea that is still very much in its infancy, and while you and I might be able to see
what it could be
, its worth a reality check on
what it is

data.title: WebMonkeys: parallel GPU programming in JavaScript (2016)
data.author: surprisetalk
data.article_summary: WebMonkeys 是一个允许在 GPU 上进行大规模并行任务的 JavaScript 库，提供简单易用的 API，适用于浏览器和 Node.js 环境，兼容 ES5 且无需 WebGL 扩展。通过 `set` 和 `get` 方法在 GPU 和 JavaScript 之间传递数据，使用 `work` 方法指定并行任务数量和任务内容，任务语言基于 GLSL 1.0。该库简化了 GPU 编程的复杂性，隐藏了 WebGL 使用中的细节问题，如数据转换和精度损失。性能方面，建议减少 `set/get` 调用，尽量在 GPU 内部处理数据以提升速度。首次调用 `work` 时由于程序编译较慢，但后续调用速度较快。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕GLSL、多核处理、GPU并行计算、以及相关技术工具的讨论

不同观点：
• **zackmorris**：认为当前的计算模式放弃了多核处理，而过度依赖GPU和AI核心。他主张开发一种能够将C代码转译为GLSL的工具，以实现自动并行化，并提出通过简单的高层次编程（如for-loops、map-reduce等）来充分利用GPU的计算能力。他还指出，当前的AI发展过于集中在LLMs（大语言模型），而忽略了其他可能的AI路径，如遗传编程。

• **kreetx**：指出该项目自2017年以来未被维护，并询问是否有其他类似项目在当前浏览器中运行。这暗示了对项目长期可用性的担忧。

• **butokai**：提到作者在交互网络（Interaction Nets）方面的工作，认为其非常酷，但注意到相关代码库最近几个月没有更新。这表明对作者其他相关工作的兴趣，但同时担忧其维护状态。

• **Anduia**：仅指出标题日期应为2016，没有提出具体观点，只是对项目时间提出修正。

• **qoez**：提到WebGPU支持原子操作，可以解决原始项目中无法直接写入2D纹理的问题，表明技术在不断进步，已有新的解决方案。

• **sylware**：询问是否存在简单的3D/GFX/游戏引擎，结合JavaScript解释器和低级图形API（如Wayland/Vulkan3D），希望找到一种轻量级且功能强大的技术方案，而不是依赖像Apple或Google的复杂引擎。

• **punkpeye**：质疑该项目的实际应用场景，询问其实际用途，表现出对项目实用性的怀疑。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点在于多核处理与GPU并行计算的优劣，以及当前AI技术发展路径的单一性。zackmorris对当前技术发展方向持批评态度，认为有更好但被忽视的途径。
• 对项目的维护状态和可行替代方案有较多关注，kreetx和butokai都提到了项目是否仍在维护以及其他类似项目的可能性。
• sylware提出的问题涉及到寻找一种简化的技术栈，显示出对当前复杂技术解决方案的不满。
• qoez指出WebGPU的新特性，表明技术在不断发展，某些原始项目中的问题在新技术下已经解决。

整体来看，讨论围绕技术实现的可行性、项目维护状态、以及不同技术路径的优劣展开，反映了参与者对当前技术发展方向的反思和替代方案的探索。

Allows you to spawn thousands of parallel tasks on the GPU with the simplest, dumbest API possible. It works on the browser (with browserify) and on Node.js. It is ES5-compatible and doesn't require any WebGL extension.
Usage
On the browser, add
<script src="WebMonkeys.js"><script>
to your HTML. On Node.js, install it from npm:
npm install webmonkeys --save
